entries.name: Aberration Hunters' Amulet
entries.description: The Aberration Hunters' Amulet is an uncommon Amulet. It grants Githyanki wearing it  Advantage on Intelligence Saving Throws and aberrations have  Disadvantage on attacks against them. The wielder can gain  Advantage on Attack Rolls against Aberrations for 3 turns, once per Short Rest.[See: Bugs]

entries.name: Absolute Confidence Amulet
entries.description: The Absolute Confidence Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer a +1 bonus to Performance checks at the cost of -1 to Intimidation checks.

entries.name: Absolute's Talisman
entries.description: Absolute's Talisman is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast a self-only version of Aid, and grants Advantage on Death Saving Throws if they bear the Absolute's Brand.

entries.name: Amulet of Elemental Torment
entries.description: The Amulet of Elemental Torment is an uncommon Amulet that channels the effects of certain Surfaces into the wearer's spells.

entries.name: Amulet of Misty Step
entries.description: Amulet of Misty Step is an uncommon amulet that grants its wearer the Misty Step spell on a short rest cooldown.

entries.name: Amulet of Selûne's Chosen
entries.description: The Amulet of Selûne's Chosen is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Selûne's Dream once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Amulet of Silvanus
entries.description: The Amulet of Silvanus is an uncommon Amulet. It allows the wearer to cast  Lesser Restoration once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Amulet of the Unworthy
entries.description: The Amulet of the Unworthy is an uncommon Amulet that protects the wearer from ⁠Slashing damage, but leaves them vulnerable to ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Beastmaster's Chain
entries.description: Beastmaster's Chain is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Animal Friendship once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Broodmother's Revenge
entries.description: The Broodmother's Revenge is an uncommon Amulet. It coats the wearer's weapon in poison for 3 turns whenever they are healed.

entries.name: Fireheart
entries.description: Fireheart is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer 2 turns of  Heat when they take Fire damage.

entries.name: Frost Prince
entries.description: Frost Prince is an uncommon Amulet which grants the wearer the ability to cast the  Ice Knife spell.

entries.name: Hammergrim Mist Amulet
entries.description: The Hammergrim Mist Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer the ability to cast the  Fog Cloud spell.

entries.name: Kill Collar
entries.description: Kill Collar is an uncommon Amulet that represents the collars used by Gortash to keep the Gondians within the Iron Foundry in check.

entries.name: Komira's Locket
entries.description:
Komira's Locket is an uncommon Amulet given to the party by  Arabella's parents.
Grants its wearer the ability to cast  Dancing Lights.

entries.name: Moondrop Pendant
entries.description: The Moondrop Pendant is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to avoid provoking Attacks of Opportunity when below 50% hit points.

entries.name: Necklace of Elemental Augmentation
entries.description: Necklace of Elemental Augmentation is an uncommon Amulet. When the wearer inflicts elemental damage with a cantrip, it adds their Spellcasting Modifier to the damage.

entries.name: Pearl of Power Amulet
entries.description: The Pearl of Power Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wielder to restore a spell slot of 3rd level or lower once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Psychic Spark
entries.description: Psychic Spark is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast a stronger version of  Magic Missile.

entries.name: Shar's Temptation
entries.description: Shar's Temptation is an Amulet that allows its wearer to cast  Charm Person once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Silver Pendant
entries.description: Silver Pendant is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Guidance.

entries.name: Spineshudder Amulet
entries.description: Spineshudder Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to inflict Reverberation when dealing damage with ranged spell attacks.

entries.name: Tarnished Charm
entries.description: The Tarnished Charm is an uncommon amulet that reduces the DC of the wearer's death saving throws.

entries.name: The Blast Pendant
entries.description: The Blast Pendant is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to focus and discharge their Lightning Charges to strengthen their next lightning spell.

entries.name: The Ever-Seeing Eye
entries.description: The Ever-Seeing Eye is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Protection from Evil and Good once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Amulet of Branding
entries.description: The Amulet of Branding is a rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast Brand the Weak once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Amulet of Restoration
entries.description: Amulet of Restoration is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Healing Word and  Mass Healing Word once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Amulet of the Drunkard
entries.description: Amulet of the Drunkard is a rare amulet. It increases the duration of Drunk to 5 turns and causes the wearer to regain 2d4 hit points once, during the first turn of  Drunk that occurs with this item equipped.

entries.name: Amulet of the Harpers
entries.description: Amulet of the Harpers is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Shield once per Long Rest and grants Advantage with Wisdom Saving Throws.

entries.name: Champion's Chain
entries.description: Champion's Chain is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to grant an ally a bonus to Intimidation.

entries.name: Chancer's Carcanet
entries.description: Chancer's Carcanet is a rare Amulet. It allows the wearer to use a reaction to make an  Attack Roll or  Saving Throw with  Advantage, once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Envoy's Amulet
entries.description: Envoy's Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to grant an ally a bonus to Persuasion.

entries.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
entries.description: Periapt of Wound Closure is a rare Amulet. Its wearer is automatically stabilised if  Downed at the start of their turn and the maximum the amount of hit points are restored to them when they receive healing.

entries.name: Sentient Amulet (Rare)
entries.description: Sentient Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Shatter once per Short Rest (with a drawback) and  Ki Restoration (lesser) once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Spell Savant Amulet
entries.description: Spell Savant Amulet is a rare Amulet that grants an additional Level 2 spell slot.

entries.name: Strange Tendril Amulet
entries.description: Strange Tendril Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Evard's Black Tentacles once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet
entries.description: The Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet is a rare Amulet that, once per Long Rest, paralyses a humanoid on a Critical Hit.

entries.name: The Amulet of Lost Voices
entries.description: The Amulet of Lost Voices is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Speak with Dead once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Uncovered Mysteries
entries.description: Uncovered Mysteries is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Detect Thoughts once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Amulet of Greater Health
entries.description: Amulet of Greater Health is a very rare Amulet which can enhance the wearer's Constitution.

entries.name: Amulet of the Devout
entries.description: The Amulet of the Devout is a very rare Amulet. It grants the wearer a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC and, if the wearer has access to it, an additional  Channel Divinity Charge.

entries.name: Amulet of Windrider
entries.description: Amulet of Windrider is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Ride the Winds and Gust of Wind. It is one of the rewards of the quest Save Vanra.

entries.name: Corvid Token
entries.description: Corvid Token is a very rare Amulet. It increases the wearer's jump distance and flying speed, grants the Polymorph: Dire Raven action, and grants Feather Fall, which persists while Polymorphed or Wild Shaped.

entries.name: Fey Semblance Amulet
entries.description: Fey Semblance Amulet is a very rare Amulet that gives the user advantage on all mental saving throws.

entries.name: Khalid's Gift
entries.description: Khalid's Gift is a very rare Amulet that was gifted to Jaheira by Khalid and stored away in the basement of her home. While wearing it, Jaheira cannot be cursed.

entries.name: Sentient Amulet (Very Rare)
entries.description: Sentient Amulet is a very rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast  Shatter once per Long Rest and  Ki Restoration (greater) once per Long Rest. It is a possible reward for the quest Help the Cursed Monk.

entries.name: Spellcrux Amulet
entries.description: Spellcrux Amulet is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to restore any one spell slot once per Long Rest.

entries.name: The Spectator Eyes
entries.description: The Spectator Eyes is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Ray of Fear and  Wounding Ray once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Tressym Collar
entries.description: Tressym Collar is a very rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast  Telekinesis once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Unflinching Protector Amulet
entries.description: Unflinching Protector Amulet is a very rare Amulet that can only be obtained from Ptaris.

entries.name: Amulet of Bhaal
entries.description: Amulet of Bhaal is a story-related Amulet which allows the wearer to inflict  Bleeding when they hit targets with maximum hit points. It also grants access to the Bhaal Temple.

entries.name: Bloody Amulet
entries.description: Bloody Amulet is an Amulet and a Story Item.

entries.name: Brass Locket
entries.description: Brass Locket is an Amulet and a Story Item.

entries.name: Mayrina's Locket
entries.description: Mayrina's Locket is an Amulet and a Story Item.

entries.name: Dauntless Amulet
entries.description: Dauntless Amulet is a rare Amulet that prevents the wearer from being Frightened.

entries.name: Ilmater's Aid
entries.description: Ilmater's Aid is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to deal additional force damage with non-cantrip spells when their health drops below half.

entries.name: Kruznabir's Asylum Amulet
entries.description: Kruznabir's Asylum Amulet is a rare Amulet that lets the user cause their targets to go mad.

entries.name: Lofty Sorcerer's Amulet
entries.description: Lofty Sorcerer's Amulet is a very rare inaccessible Amulet that grants the wearer an additional sorcery point.

entries.name: Scarab of Protection
entries.description: Scarab of Protection is a legendary Amulet.

entries.name: Synaptic Needle Amulet
entries.description: Synaptic Needle Amulet is a rare Amulet.

entries.name: Treacleflow Amulet
entries.description: Treacleflow Amulet is a rare Amulet.

entries.name: Wakeful Amulet
entries.description: Wakeful Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that prevents the user from being put to sleep.

entries.description: Bandit's Armour is a common Light Armour, and can only be obtained under specific circumstances.

entries.description: Selunite Robe is a common Light Armour.

entries.description: Studded Leather Armour is a common Light Armour.

entries.name: Blazer of Benevolence
entries.description: The Blazer of Benevolence is an uncommon Light Armour that grants the wearer Temporary Hit Points when they inspire an ally with Bardic Inspiration.

entries.name: Leather Armour +1
entries.description: Leather Armour +1 is an uncommon Light Armour that grants a +1 bonus to Stealth checks.

entries.name: Padded Armour +1
entries.description: Padded Armour +1 is a uncommon Light Armour.

entries.name: Scarlet Leather Armour
entries.description: Scarlet Leather Armour is an uncommon Light Armour that grants its wearer +1 to Stealth checks.

entries.name: Studded Leather Armour +1
entries.description: Studded Leather Armour +1 is an uncommon Light Armour that reduces Bludgeoning damage by 1.

entries.name: Drow Studded Leather Armour
entries.description: Drow Studded Leather Armour is a rare Light Armour that aids the wearer with Stealth checks.

entries.name: Leather Armour +2
entries.description: Leather Armour +2 is an uncommon Light Armour that grants a +1 bonus to Stealth checks as well as Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

entries.name: Padded Armour +2
entries.description: Padded Armour +2 is a rare Light Armour that reduces Bludgeoning damage by 2.

entries.name: Penumbral Armour
entries.description: Penumbral Armour is a rare Light Armour that enhances Stealth when the wearer is Obscured.

entries.name: Shadeclinger Armour
entries.description: Shadeclinger Armour is a rare Light Armour that grants Advantage on Saving Throws while Obscured.

entries.name: Spidersilk Armour
entries.description: Spidersilk Armour is a rare Light Armour that aids the wearer with Stealth checks and Constitution Saving Throws.

entries.name: Studded Leather Armour +2
entries.description: Studded Leather Armour +2 is a rare Light Armour that reduces Bludgeoning damage by 1 and also boosts Initiative by 1.

entries.name: Armour of Landfall
entries.description: Armour of Landfall is a very rare light armour which improves the spellcasting ability of its wearer and grants  Advantage on Constitution  Saving Throws. The wearer also heals while standing in vines and can cast  Plant Growth.

entries.name: Armour of Moonbasking
entries.description: Armour of Moonbasking is a very rare Light Armour that bestows Temporary Hit Points and Armour Class to its wielder when they Wild Shape.

entries.name: Armour of the Sporekeeper
entries.description: Armour of the Sporekeeper is a very rare Light Armour that enhances the wearer's Necrotic damage and Symbiotic Entity ability with 3 new abilities.

entries.name: Bhaalist Armour
entries.description: Bhaalist Armour is a very rare Light Armour which grants Aura of Murder and a bonus to Initiative rolls.

entries.name: Elegant Studded Leather
entries.description: Elegant Studded Leather is a very rare Light Armour which provides bonuses to initiative, Advantage on Stealth checks, and grants access to the Shield spell.[See: Bugs]

entries.description: Breastplate +1 is an uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Piercing damage.

entries.description: Chain Shirt +1 is an uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Slashing damage.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Mail
entries.description: Dark Justiciar Mail is an uncommon Medium Armour that deals ⁠Necrotic damage to creatures that hit the wearer with a melee attack while the wearer is Obscured by shadow.

entries.description: Half Plate Armour +1 is a uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Piercing damage.

entries.name: Hedge Wanderer Armour
entries.description: The Hedge Wanderer Armour is an uncommon Medium Armour that provides a small boost to Dexterity related rolls and towards Nature Skill Checks.

entries.name: Hide Armour +1
entries.description: Hide Armour +1 is a uncommon Medium Armour.

entries.name: Luminous Armour
entries.description: Luminous Armour is an uncommon Medium Armour that allows the wearer to cause radiant shockwaves whenever they deal Radiant damage.

entries.name: Scale Mail +1
entries.description: Scale Mail +1 is a uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Slashing damage.

entries.name: Slippery Chain Shirt
entries.description: The Slippery Chain Shirt is an uncommon Medium Armour. It allows the wearer to move without provoking Opportunity Attacks after healing a creature.

entries.name: The Oak Father's Embrace
entries.description: The Oak Father's Embrace is an uncommon Medium Armour that deals Radiant damage to creatures violating the natural order, including the wearer.

entries.name: Barkskin Armour
entries.description: Barkskin Armour is a rare Medium Armour that sets the user's Armour Class to 16 and grants Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

entries.name: Breastplate +2
entries.description: Breastplate +2 is a rare Medium Armour that reduces Piercing damage and grants a +1 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

entries.name: Chain Shirt +2
entries.description: Chain Shirt +2 is a rare Medium Armour that reduces Slashing damage and grants a +1 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Half-Plate (Rare)
entries.description: Dark Justiciar Half-Plate is a rare Medium Armour that grants Advantage on Stealth checks while Obscured in shadow. It also grants Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws and allows its wearer to cast a version of Shield of Faith once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Elven Chain
entries.description: Elven Chain is a rare Medium Armour that grants its wearer bonuses to Initiative Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws.

entries.name: Half Plate Armour +2
entries.description: Half Plate Armour +2 is a rare Medium Armour that moderately reduces Piercing damage.

entries.name: Hide Armour +2
entries.description: Hide Armour +2 is a rare Medium Armour that grants a +1 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks, as well as Initiative.

entries.name: Psionic Ward Armour
entries.description: Psionic Ward Armour is a set of rare Medium Armour. It heals the wearer if they if they pass a Saving Throw against a spell, and gives them Resistance to Psychic damage if they are Githyanki.

entries.name: Scale Mail +2
entries.description: Scale Mail +2 is a rare Medium Armour.

entries.name: The Jolty Vest
entries.description: The Jolty Vest is a Rare Medium Armour that shocks enemies who land attacks on the wearer while they have Lightning Charges.

entries.name: Unwanted Masterwork Scalemail
entries.description: The Unwanted Masterwork Scalemail is a rare Medium Armour which does not limit the wearer's AC's Dexterity bonus. It is part of the Unwanted set.

entries.name: Yuan-Ti Scale Mail
entries.description: Yuan-Ti Scale Mail is a rare Medium Armour that adds the wearer's Dexterity Modifier to their Armour Class and also grants a +1 bonus to Initiative.

entries.name: Adamantine Scale Mail
entries.description: Adamantine Scale Mail is a very rare Medium Armour that reduces all incoming damage by 1 and sends attackers Reeling. In addition, attacks cannot land Critical Hits on the user.

entries.name: Armour of Agility
entries.description: The Armour of Agility is a very rare Medium Armour that doesn't limit your AC's Dexterity bonus, and boosts all of the user's Saving Throws by 2.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Half-Plate (Very Rare)
entries.description: Dark Justiciar Half-Plate is a very rare Medium Armour that grants Advantage on Stealth checks while Obscured in shadow. It also grants Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws, allows its wearer to cast Shield of Faith once per Long Rest, and reduces damage while Shield of Faith is active on its wearer.

entries.name: Flame Enamelled Armour
entries.description: Flame Enamelled Armour is a very rare Medium Armour. It grants a +2 bonus to Initiative, Resistance to Fire damage and +2 to all Saving Throws. It also allows the user to cast the Fire Shield: Warm spell.

entries.name: Sharpened Snare Cuirass
entries.description: Sharpened Snare Cuirass is a very rare Medium Armour that adds your full Dexterity Modifier to your Armour Class. Enemies also have Disadvantage when resisting your attacks and Saving Throws that inflict Restrained.

entries.description: Chain Mail is a common Heavy Armour.

entries.description: Plate Armour is a common Heavy Armour.

entries.description: Ring Mail Armour is a common Heavy Armour.

entries.description: Splint Armour is a common Heavy Armour.

entries.description: Chain Mail +1 is an uncommon Heavy Armour that reduces Slashing damage.

entries.name: Plate Armour +1
entries.description: Plate Armour +1 is an uncommon Heavy Armour that reduces Piercing damage.

entries.name: Protective Plate
entries.description: Protective Plate is a set of Heavy Armour that grants Resistance to Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Ring Mail Armour +1
entries.description: Ring Mail Armour +1 is a uncommon Heavy Armour that grants a +1 bonus to Strength Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

entries.name: Splint Armour +1
entries.description: Splint Armour +1 is a uncommon Heavy Armour that reduces Piercing damage by 1.

entries.name: Armour of Devotion
entries.description: Armour of Devotion is a set of rare Full Plate Heavy Armour that allows the wearer to cast Eternal Devotion, restoring a charge of their Paladin Channel Oath ability.

entries.name: Cerebral Citadel Armour
entries.description: Cerebral Citadel Armour is a rare Heavy Armour. If the wearer is infested by a mind flayer tadpole, it grants them immunity to being Frightened and gives a +1 bonus to all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

entries.name: Chain Mail +2
entries.description: Chain Mail +2 is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces Slashing damage by 2.

entries.name: Dwarven Splintmail
entries.description: Dwarven Splintmail is a rare heavy armour that reduces Piercing damage by 1 and grants a +1 bonus to Strength Saving Throws and Ability Checks. In addition, it also boosts the user's Constitution by 2.

entries.name: Flawed Helldusk Armour
entries.description: Flawed Helldusk Armour is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces Piercing damage by 1 and possibly deals 1d4 Fire damage to attackers.

entries.name: Plate Armour +2
entries.description: Plate Armour +2 is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces damage from Piercing, Bludgeoning and Slashing sources by 2.

entries.name: Ring Mail Armour +2
entries.description: Ring Mail Armour +2 is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces Slashing damage by 1 and grants a +1 bonus to Strength Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

entries.name: Rippling Force Mail
entries.description: Rippling Force Mail is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces physical damage taken and causes its wearer to deal force damage around them after being struck with physical attacks enough times.

entries.name: Splint Armour +2
entries.description: Splint Armour +2 is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces Piercing damage by 1 and grants a +1 bonus to Strength Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

entries.name: Adamantine Splint Armour
entries.description: Adamantine Splint Armour is a very rare Heavy Armour that reduces all incoming damage by 2 and sends attackers Reeling. In addition, attacks cannot land Critical Hits on the wearer.

entries.name: Armour of Persistence
entries.description: Armour of Persistence is a very rare Armour that grants its wearer permanent Resistance and Blade Ward effects in addition to reducing all damage taken by 2.

entries.name: Blackguard's Plate
entries.description: Blackguard's Plate is a very rare Heavy Armour that reduces all incoming damage by 1 and grants Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws.

entries.name: Emblazoned Plate of the Marshal
entries.description: Emblazoned Plate of the Marshal is a very rare Heavy Armour that reduces all damage by 2, grants Fire Resistance, and the ability to cast Fire Shield.

entries.name: Reaper's Embrace
entries.description: Reaper's Embrace is a very rare heavy Armour that reduces incoming damage by 2 and makes the wearer immune to being moved by force. It also grants the Howl of the Dead class action.

entries.name: Helldusk Armour
entries.description: Helldusk Armour is a legendary heavy Armour which can be worn without any proficiency. It grants Fire resistance, reduces damage by 3 from all sources, and grants the Fly spell.

entries.name: Absolute Outfit
entries.description: Absolute Outfit is a set of common Camp Clothing.

entries.description: Anarchic Blue Outfit is an article of common Camp Clothing.

entries.description: Cloak is a common Cloak that provides no bonuses to the wearer.

entries.name: Cindermoth Cloak
entries.description: Cindermoth Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that inflicts Burning on any foe within 2 m (7 ft) which damages the wearer.

entries.name: Cloak of Cunning Brume
entries.description: Cloak of Cunning Brume is an uncommon Cloak which grants the user a  smokescreen cloud effect when trying to  Disengage.

entries.name: Cloak of Elemental Absorption
entries.description: Cloak of Elemental Absorption is an uncommon Cloak that allows the wearer to absorb a small amount of magical damage, and add it to their next attack.

entries.name: Cloak of Protection
entries.description: Cloak of Protection is an uncommon Cloak which grants the wearer +1  Armour Class and +1 to  Saving Throws

entries.name: Fleshmelter Cloak
entries.description: Fleshmelter Cloak is an uncommon Cloak. It deals acid damage to creatures that deal melee damage to the wearer.

entries.name: Reverse Rain Cloak
entries.description: Reverse Rain Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that grants the user the condition  Wet while worn, increasing resistance to ⁠Fire, but granting vulnerability to ⁠Lightning and ⁠Cold damage.

entries.name: Thunderskin Cloak
entries.description: Thunderskin Cloak is an uncommon Cloak which has a chance to  Daze creatures that are  Reverberating when they damage the wearer.

entries.name: Vivacious Cloak
entries.description: Vivacious Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that grants the wearer 8 temporary Hit Points when casting a spell in melee.

entries.name: Cloak of Displacement
entries.description: Cloak of Displacement is a rare Cloak that, every turn, subjects enemy attacks against its wearer to Disadvantage until the wearer takes damage.

entries.name: Derivation Cloak
entries.description: Derivation Cloak is a rare Cloak which heals the wearer for 1d4 Hit Points when they Poison a foe.

entries.name: The Deathstalker Mantle
entries.description: The Deathstalker Mantle is a rare Cloak that turns the wearer Invisible for 2 turns after killing an enemy.

entries.name: Wavemother's Cloak
entries.description: Wavemother's Cloak is a rare Cloak that grants its wearer Water Layer Protection every turn.

entries.name: Cloak of the Weave
entries.description: Cloak of the Weave is a very rare Cloak that allows the wearer to absorb a small amount of magical damage, and add it to their next attack. It also increases Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls.

entries.name: Mantle of the Holy Warrior
entries.description: The Mantle of the Holy Warrior is a Very Rare Cloak that grants the wearer the ability to cast Crusader's Mantle.

entries.name: Nymph Cloak
entries.description: Nymph Cloak is a very rare Cloak that allows the wearer to cast Dominate Person once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Shade-Slayer Cloak
entries.description: Shade-Slayer Cloak is a very rare Cloak that reduces the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while hiding.

entries.name: Braindrain Cape
entries.description: Braindrain Cape is a rare Cloak that exhausts attackers with mental fatigue.

entries.name: Cloak of Avarice
entries.description: The Cloak of Avarice is a rare cloak.

entries.name: Minsc Cloak
entries.description: Minsc Cloak is a common Cloak; it provides no bonuses to the wearer.

entries.description: Phasmid Cloak is a common Cloak that provides no bonuses to the wearer.

entries.name: Sorcerer Robe
entries.description: The Sorcerer Robe is a common piece of Clothing and the starting armour for a Wild Magic sorcerer.

entries.name: Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo
entries.description: The Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo is an uncommon piece of Clothing that allows the wearer to counter attack an enemy that misses them, so long as Patient Defence is active.

entries.name: Bided Time
entries.description: Bided Time is uncommon Clothing that causes the wearer to gain Arcane Charge whenever they are hit by a melee attack.

entries.name: Bloodguzzler Garb
entries.description: The Bloodguzzler Garb is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants its wearer Wrath when an enemy damages the wearer.

entries.name: Cloth Armour
entries.description: Cloth Armour is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants Wrath when an enemy damages the wearer.

entries.name: Poisoner's Robe
entries.description: The Poisoner's Robe is an uncommon piece of Clothing that makes the wearer's poison spells deal more damage.

entries.name: Robe of Summer
entries.description: The Robe of Summer is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants its wearer Resistance to Cold damage.

entries.name: Cloth of Authority
entries.description: Cloth of Authority is a rare piece of Clothing that grants immunity to emotion-altering conditions. It also grants +1 Armour Class as well as Advantage on Intimidation and Insight checks.

entries.name: Drunken Cloth
entries.description: Drunken Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing that grants the wearer Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws while Drunk. They also gain temporary hit points at the start of each turn.

entries.name: Enraging Heart Garb
entries.description: The Enraging Heart Garb is a rare piece of Clothing that grants Wrath while the wearer is Raging. It also increases Constitution by 2.

entries.name: Garb of the Land and Sky
entries.description: Garb of the Land and Sky is rare piece of Clothing that grants the wearer Blade Ward when using Patient Defence. When using Step of the Wind, the wearer's next Attack Roll has Advantage and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.
entries.wikiTitle: Garb of the Land and Sky

entries.name: Icebite Robe
entries.description: Icebite Robe is a rare piece of Clothing. It grants the wearer Resistance to Cold damage and allows them to cast Armour of Agathys as a 3rd level spell once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Mutilated Carapace
entries.description: Mutilated Carapace is a rare piece of Clothing that grants its wearer a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls while disguised, as well as Advantage on Deception and Persuasion Ability Checks.

entries.name: Obsidian Laced Robe
entries.description: Obsidian Laced Robe is rare piece of Clothing that deals Fire damage to enemies on successful Saving Throws against their spells, and grants its wearer resistance to Fire damage.

entries.name: Robe of Exquisite Focus
entries.description: The Robe of Exquisite Focus is a rare article of Clothing that increases its wearer's Spell Save DC.

entries.name: Shelter of Athkatla
entries.description: Shelter of Athkatla is a rare piece of Clothing that grants the wearer Advantage on spell Saving Throws, as well as the ability to cast Mirror Image.

entries.name: The Graceful Cloth
entries.description: The Graceful Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing which gives its wearer +2 Dexterity and the Cat's Grace condition. It also boosts their Dexterity Saving Throws and jump distance.

entries.name: The Mighty Cloth
entries.description: The Mighty Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing that gives its wearer +2 Strength (up to 20) and the Bull's Strength condition. Also grants the wearer the Bull Rush class action.

entries.name: The Protecty Sparkswall
entries.description: The Protecty Sparkswall is a rare article of Clothing. It increases the wearer's defences while they have Lightning Charges and grants a +1 bonus to their Spell Save DC.

entries.name: Viconia's Priestess Robe
entries.description: Viconia's Priestess Robe is a rare piece of Clothing that grants the wearer Advantage on Stealth checks while Obscured, and enhances Shield of Faith to give a +2 to all Saving Throws as well.

entries.name: Bonespike Garb
entries.description: Bonespike Garb is a very rare piece of Clothing that grants temporary hit points when using Rage, and reduces incoming damage by 2. Attackers receive Piercing damage when the wearer is struck.

entries.name: Infernal Robe
entries.description: Infernal Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing that grants its wearer resistance to Fire damage as well as the ability to cast Fire Shield (Warm), once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Moon Devotion Robe
entries.description: Moon Devotion Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing. It grants Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws as well as the ability to cast Produce Flame and Lunar Bulwark.[See: Bugs]

entries.name: Potent Robe
entries.description: The Potent Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing that uses the wearer's Charisma modifier to increase their cantrips' damage as well as give them temporary hit points.

entries.name: Robe of Supreme Defences
entries.description: The Robe of Supreme Defences is a very rare piece of Clothing. It adds the wearer's Spellcasting Modifier to their Saving Throws while concentrating on a spell.

entries.name: Robe of the Weave
entries.description: Robe of the Weave is a very rare piece of Clothing. It heals the wearer when they succeeding a saving throw against a spell, and boosts their Spell Save DCs and Spell Attack Rolls rolls by 1 each.

entries.name: Veil of the Morning
entries.description: Veil of the Morning is a very rare piece of Clothing that imposes Disadvantage on Undead Attack Rolls against the wearer, grants them Advantage against Undead spells and actions, and allows them to Turn Undead.

entries.name: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation
entries.description: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation is a very rare piece of Clothing. It heals the wearer on a successful saving throw against a spell and allows them to use a Reaction to make an Unarmed Attack against any attacker that misses.

entries.name: Wavemother's Robe
entries.description: Wavemother's Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing which heals the wearer while standing in  Water. It also grants Resistance to Fire and Cold damage, and allows them to cast  Create or Destroy Water.

entries.name: Robe +1
entries.description: The Robe +1 is an uncommon enchanted robe.

entries.name: Robe of Spell Resistance
entries.description: Robe of Spell Resistance is a rare Clothing that allows the wearer to resist the effects of spells.

entries.description: Boots of Stormy Clamour are an uncommon pair of Boots that inflict the  Reverberation condition on a creature when afflicting it with another condition.

entries.name: Boots of Very Fast Blinking
entries.description: Boots of Very Fast Blinking are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant the wearer the ability to cast  Misty Step once per turn, but with the drawback that their clothes are left behind.

entries.name: Cinder Shoes
entries.description: Cinder Shoes is a pair of uncommon Boots that grants Heat whenever the wearer Burns an enemy.

entries.name: Hoarfrost Boots
entries.description: Hoarfrost Boots are an uncommon pair of Boots that allow the wearer to not slip on icy surfaces.

entries.name: Mystra's Grace
entries.description: Mystra's Grace is an uncommon pair of Boots that allow the wearer to cast the Feather Fall spell at will.

entries.name: Spiderstep Boots
entries.description: Spiderstep Boots are an uncommon pair of Boots that allow the wearer to walk across webs freely.

entries.name: Tyrannical Jackboots
entries.description: Tyrannical Jackboots are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant a +1 bonus to Charisma checks and Saving Throws.

entries.name: Varsh Ko'kuu's Boots
entries.description: Varsh Ko'kuu's Boots are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant immunity to Acid surfaces and Resistance to Acid damage.

entries.name: Acrobat Shoes
entries.description: Acrobat Shoes is a pair of rare Boots that grants a bonus to Acrobatics and Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

entries.name: Boots of Apparent Death
entries.description: Boots of Apparent Death are a rare set of Boots that grants the wearer the ability to cast Feign Death once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Boots of Arcane Bolstering
entries.description: Boots of Arcane Bolstering is a pair of rare Boots that grants Arcane Charge each time the wearer Dashes, adding +1 bonus to damage with spells while Threatened.

entries.name: Boots of Brilliance
entries.description: Boots of Brilliance are a rare pair of Boots that allow the wearer to replenish one Bardic Inspiration charge once per long rest.

entries.name: Boots of Genial Striding
entries.description: Boots of Genial Striding is a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to move over difficult terrain without impediment.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
entries.description: The Boots of Speed is a pair of rare Boots that allows the wearer to click their heels for a burst of speed that makes it difficult for enemies to land Attacks of Opportunity on them.

entries.name: Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo
entries.description: The Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo are a rare pair of Boots that add the wearer's Wisdom modifier to their Unarmed Strike damage.

entries.name: Evasive Shoes
entries.description: The Evasive Shoes are a rare pair of Boots that give a small bonus to Acrobatics and Armour Class.

entries.name: Linebreaker Boots
entries.description: The Linebreaker Boots are a rare pair of Boots that grants the wearer Wrath whenever they Dash.

entries.name: Slinging Shoes
entries.description: Slinging Shoes is a pair of Boots. They deal psychic damage and return to the wearer when thrown.

entries.name: Spaceshunt Boots
entries.description: Spaceshunt Boots is a rare pair of Boots that allow the wearer to cast the Dimension Door spell as an Action once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Springstep Boots
entries.description: Springstep Boots is a pair of rare Boots that allows the wearer to gain Momentum whenever they dash in combat, further improving their Movement Speed.

entries.name: Swiresy Shoes
entries.description: The Swiresy Shoes are a pair of rare Boots that improve Jumping distance and Acrobatics skill.

entries.name: The Watersparkers
entries.description: The Watersparkers are a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to electrify water surfaces and gain Lightning Charges.

entries.name: Bonespike Boots
entries.description: Bonespike Boots are a Very rare pair of Boots that enhances jump distance and gives the character access to the Brutal Leap ability.

entries.name: Helldusk Boots
entries.description: The Helldusk Boots are a very rare pair of Boots that allows the wearer to ignore Difficult Terrain, and to use a  Reaction to succeed on a Saving Throw. It also grants the Hellcrawler bonus action.

entries.name: Disintegrating Night Walkers
entries.description: The Disintegrating Night Walkers are story-related Boots which grant their wearer immunity to various surface effects, and also allows them to cast Misty Step once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Dreamsome Boots
entries.description: Dreamsome Boots are a pair of Boots worn by the guardian who appears in the player character's dreams.

entries.name: Githyanki Boots
entries.description: Githyanki Boots are a common pair of Boots.

entries.name: Metallic Boots
entries.description: Metallic Boots are a common pair of Boots.

entries.name: Boots of Elemental Momentum
entries.description: The Boots of Elemental Momentum are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant Momentum whenever the wearer deals elemental damage with a spell or cantrip.

entries.name: Boots of Striding
entries.description: The Boots of Striding are an uncommon pair of Boots that grants the wearer a burst of speed whenever they begin concentrating on a spell.

entries.name: Blackguard's Greaves
entries.description: Blackguard's Greaves are a rare pair of Greaves that grant their wearer a permanent Longstrider effect and a +1 bonus to Athletics.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Boots
entries.description: The Dark Justiciar Boots are a rare pair of Boots that grants the wearer better Dexterity Saving Throws and the ability to cast Shadow Teleportation once per Short Rest.

entries.name: The Speedy Lightfeet
entries.description: The Speedy Lightfeet are a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to gain Lightning Charges when Dashing in combat.

entries.name: Unwanted Masterwork Greaves
entries.description: Unwanted Masterwork Greaves are a rare pair of Boots that provide a bonus to Athletics. It is part of the Unwanted set.

entries.name: Vital Conduit Boots
entries.description: The Vital Conduit Boots are a pair of rare Boots that grants the wearer temporary Hit Points when they cast a Spell that requires Concentration.

entries.name: Boots of Persistence
entries.description: Boots of Persistence is a pair of Boots that grant their wearer permanent Freedom of Movement and Longstrider effects.

entries.name: Boots of Psionic Movement
entries.description: Boots of Psionic Movement are a very rare pair of Boots that allow Githyanki wearers to fly, and enhances their attacks with Psychic damage.

entries.name: Bicorne of the Sea Beast
entries.description: Bicorne of the Sea Beast is a common Helmet.

entries.name: Brimmed Hat
entries.description: Brimmed Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Bycocket
entries.description: Bycocket is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Cap and Bells
entries.description: Cap and Bells is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Circlet
entries.description: The Circlet is a common Circlet.

entries.name: Devilfoil Mask
entries.description: A Devilfoil Mask is a common Helmet worn by Merregons that increases the wearer's Strength by 1 and decreases the wearer's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma by 1 per nearby mask.

entries.name: Embroidered Bycocket
entries.description: Embroidered Bycocket is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Embroidered Hat
entries.description: Embroidered Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Frumpy Hat
entries.description: Frumpy Hat is a common non-armour Headwear.

entries.name: Hat of Eminent Giggles
entries.description: Hat Of Eminent Giggles is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Ignoble Hat
entries.description: Ignoble Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Old Floppy Hat
entries.description: Old Floppy Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Rufflesome Blaggart Hat
entries.description: Rufflesome Blaggart Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Snakeskin Hat
entries.description: Snakeskin Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Whispering Mask
entries.description: Whispering Mask is a common Helmet with connections to Auntie Ethel.

entries.name: Wide-Brimmed Hat
entries.description: Wide-Brimmed Hat is a common non-armour Headwear.

entries.name: Wizard Hat
entries.description: Wizard Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.

entries.name: Browbeaten Circlet
entries.description: Browbeaten Circlet is an uncommon piece of Headwear that grants the wearer a bonus to spell save DC while being threatened.

entries.name: Cap of Curing
entries.description: The Cap of Curing is an uncommon Hat that heals those inspired by the wearer using Bardic Inspiration.

entries.name: Coldbrim Hat
entries.description: Coldbrim Hat is an uncommon Hat where, once per turn, if a condition is inflicted on the target, the hat also applies 2 turns of  Encrusted with Frost.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Mask
entries.description: Dark Justiciar Mask is an uncommon Helmet that grants the wearer a bonus to Intimidation checks.

entries.name: Hat of Fire Acuity
entries.description: Hat of Fire Acuity is an uncommon hat that grants the wearer  Arcane Acuity whenever they deal Fire damage.

entries.name: Hat of Storm Scion's Power
entries.description: Hat of Storm Scion's Power is an uncommon hat that grants  Arcane Acuity whenever the wearer deals ⁠Thunder damage.

entries.name: Infernal Mask
entries.description: Infernal Mask is an uncommon Helmet carried by Orpheus.

entries.name: Key of the Ancients
entries.description: This version of the Key of the Ancients is a story rarity Helmet which grants the wearer a bonus to Nature checks.

entries.name: Marksmanship Hat
entries.description: Marksmanship Hat is an uncommon hat that grants its wearer a bonus to ranged and thrown attack rolls.

entries.name: The Lifebringer
entries.description: The Lifebringer is an uncommon circlet which grants the wearer temporary hit points whenever they gain Lightning Charges.

entries.name: The Shadespell Circlet
entries.description: The Shadespell Circlet is an uncommon Helmet that grants a bonus to Spell Save DC when the wearer is obscured in shadow.

entries.name: Wapira's Crown
entries.description: Wapira's Crown is an uncommon Helmet that heals the wearer whenever they heal another creature.

entries.name: Warped Headband of Intellect
entries.description: The Warped Headband of Intellect is an uncommon Circlet that raises the wearer's Intelligence to 17.

entries.name: Cap of Wrath
entries.description: The Cap of Wrath is a rare Helmet that grants the wearer  Wrath when they start the turn with 50% Hit Points or less.

entries.name: Circle of Bones
entries.description: Circle of Bones is a rare Circlet that grants all nearby allied undead Resistance to physical damage, and the wearer can cast Animate Dead once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Circlet of Blasting
entries.description: The Circlet of Blasting is a rare circlet that grants the wearer the ability to cast the Scorching Ray spell.

entries.name: Circlet of Mental Anguish
entries.description: The Circlet of Mental Anguish is a rare Circlet that heals the wearer for 1d4 hit points when an enemy fails a Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom Saving Throw against one of the wearer's spells or cantrips.

entries.name: Circlet of Psionic Revenge
entries.description: The Circlet of Psionic Revenge is a rare Circlet which allows Gith to enhance their saving throws and punish casters with psychic damage.

entries.name: Diadem of Arcane Synergy
entries.description: The Diadem of Arcane Synergy is a rare circlet that grants  Arcane Synergy when the wearer inflicts a condition.

entries.name: Fistbreaker Helm
entries.description: Fistbreaker Helm is a rare Helmet that grants a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and +1 to Initiative Rolls.

entries.name: Gibus of the Worshipful Servant
entries.description: Gibus of the Worshipful Servant is a rare Headwear which grants  Momentum equal to the wearer's Charisma Modifier at the start of combat and Advantage on Concentration Saving Throws.

entries.name: Haste Helm
entries.description: The Haste Helm is a rare helmet that grants the wearer a burst of speed at the start of combat.

entries.name: Hat of the Sharp Caster
entries.description: The Hat of the Sharp Caster is a rare Helmet. It rerolls the die(s) on spell damage rolls if they are a 1 or 2.

entries.name: Hat of Uninhibited Kushigo
entries.description: The Hat of Uninhibited Kushigo is a rare hat that grants +1 bonus to their Spell Save DC after dealing damage with an unarmed attack.

entries.name: Scabby Pugilist Circlet
entries.description: The Scabby Pugilist Circlet is a rare Helmet that grants additional damage on weapon and unarmed strikes while surrounded by 2 or more foes.

entries.name: The Pointy Hat
entries.description: The Pointy Hat is a rare hat that gives the wearer a bonus to their persuasion checks equal to their Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Assassin of Bhaal Cowl
entries.description: Assassin of Bhaal Cowl is a very rare Helmet which grants a bonus to  Initiative. It also allows the wearer to see in the dark and cast See Invisibility.

entries.name: Birthright
entries.description: Birthright is a very rare Headwear that gives the wearer Charisma +2, up to a maximum of 22.

entries.name: Bonespike Helmet
entries.description: Bonespike Helmet is a very rare Helmet. If the wearer rages, the helmet forces all hostile creatures within a 3m radius to roll a wisdom saving throw. Those failing this roll take 2-8 Psychic damage; a successful roll halves this.

entries.name: Circlet of Hunting
entries.description: The Circlet of Hunting is a very rare circlet which grants a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls against marked creatures.

entries.name: Helldusk Helmet
entries.description: Helldusk Helmet is a very rare Headwear. It grants the wearer the ability to see in magical darkness, and they cannot be blinded. They also gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against spells and can use  Immolating Gaze to frighten enemies.

entries.name: Hood of the Weave
entries.description: Hood of the Weave is a very rare Helmet that boosts its wearer's Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls by 2.

entries.name: Horns of the Berserker
entries.description: Horns of the Berserker is a very rare Helmet which grants a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls against damaged creatures, and an extra 2⁠⁠Necrotic damage to melee hits made while damaged.

entries.name: Jannath's Hat
entries.description: Jannath's Hat is a very rare headwear that gives advantage to persuasion and deception checks.

entries.name: Mask of Soul Perception
entries.description: Mask of Soul Perception is a very rare Helmet that increases a wearer's Attack Rolls, Initiative Rolls, and Perception Checks by 2. The wearer can also cast Detect Thoughts once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Pyroquickness Hat
entries.description: Pyroquickness Hat is a very rare Hat that burns the wearer when casting a Fire spell, but also grants them an extra Bonus Action.

entries.name: Shapeshifter Hat
entries.description: Shapeshifter Hat is a very rare Headwear that grants the wearer one additional Wild Shape Charge per Long Rest.

entries.name: Mask of the Shapeshifter
entries.description: Mask of the Shapeshifter is a legendary Mask that allows the wearer to cast Disguise Self at will.

entries.name: Angelic Plume Helmet
entries.description: An Angelic Plume Helmet is a common Helmet.

entries.name: Frayed Drow Hood
entries.description: A Frayed Drow Hood is a common Helmet.

entries.description: A Leather Helmet is a common Helmet.

entries.description: A Leatherstring Helmet is a common Helmet.

entries.description: A Red Carmine Mask is a common Helmet.

entries.name: Rich Arcanist Helmet
entries.description: A Rich Arcanist Helmet is a common Helmet.

entries.name: Scorpion Helmet
entries.description: Scorpion Helmet is a common Helmet.

entries.name: Covert Cowl
entries.description: Covert Cowl is an uncommon Helmet that makes the wearer's critical hits more likely when they are obscured.

entries.name: Helmet of Arcane Acuity
entries.description: The Helmet of Arcane Acuity is an uncommon Helmet that imparts Arcane Acuity upon the wearer when they deal damage with a weapon attack.

entries.name: Helmet of Autonomy
entries.description: The Helmet of Autonomy is an uncommon Helmet that grants the wearer Proficiency in Wisdom Saving Throws.

entries.name: Shadow of Menzoberranzan
entries.description: The Shadow of Menzoberranzan is a rare Helmet that allows the wearer to use Shrouded in Shadow to become Invisible.

entries.name: Helmet of Grit
entries.description: The Helmet of Grit is a very rare Helmet. It  grants the wearer an additional Bonus Action at 50% or lower Hit Points.

entries.name: Adjustable Steel Helm
entries.description: Adjustable Steel Helm is a common Helmet.

entries.name: Blackplume Helm
entries.description: Blackplume Helm is a common Helmet, it provides minimal bonuses to a character but may be worn of aesthetic reasons.

entries.name: Blaze Portyr's Ceremonial Flaming Fist Helm
entries.description: Blaze Portyr's Ceremonial Flaming Fist Helm is a common Helmet. It is a unique variant of Flaming Fist Helmet.

entries.description: Cracked Helm of Shar is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.

entries.description: Triumphal Helm is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.
