entries.name: Well Crated Helm
entries.description: A Well Crated Helm is a common helmet.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Helm
entries.description: A Dark Justiciar Helm is an uncommon Helmet worn by Shar's Dark Justiciars that grants a bonus to Saving Throws while obscured by shadow.

entries.name: Helmet of Smiting
entries.description: The Helmet of Smiting is an uncommon Helmet which grants the wearer Temporary Hit Points whenever they apply a Condition using a Smite spell.

entries.name: Holy Lance Helm
entries.description: A Holy Lance Helm is an uncommon Helmet that potentially deals radiant damage to creatures that attack the wearer.

entries.name: Flawed Helldusk Helmet
entries.description: Flawed Helldusk Helmet is a rare Helmet crafted from Infernal Iron that improves the wearer's saving throws against spells by 2.

entries.name: Steelwatcher Helmet
entries.description: Steel Watcher Helmet is a rare Helmet that grants the wearer Darkvision and immunity to Blindness. It also grants Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Helmet
entries.description: The Dark Justiciar Helmet is a very rare Helmet that improves the wearer's Saving Throws against Spells and makes Critical Hits more likely while the wearer is obscured by darkness.

entries.name: Sarevok's Horned Helmet
entries.description: Sarevok's Horned Helmet is a very rare Headwear that grants Darkvision to its wearer and increases critical hit chance. You also cannot be Frightened.

entries.name: Helm of Balduran
entries.description: Helm of Balduran is a legendary Headwear once worn by the fabled founder of Baldur's Gate, Balduran, and grants hit points every turn along with stun and critical hit immunities.

entries.name: Grymskull Helm
entries.description: The Grymskull Helm is a very rare helmet. It grants fire resistance, protects its wearer from critical hits and grants the Hunter's Mark spell.

entries.name: Drow Leather Gloves
entries.description: Drow Leather Gloves are a common pair of Gloves worn by the Drow.

entries.name: Druidic Bracers
entries.description: Druidic Gloves are a common pair of Gloves.

entries.name: Gloves (Equipment)
entries.description: Gloves are a common pair of Gloves. While coming in varying appearances, these gloves offer no benefits beyond cosmetic appeal or as an item to sell off.

entries.name: Leather Bracers
entries.description: Leather Bracers are a common pair of Gloves. These bracers offer no benefits beyond cosmetic appeal or as an item to sell off.

entries.name: Leather Gloves
entries.description: Leather Gloves are a common pair of Gloves. While coming in varying appearances, these gloves offer no benefits beyond cosmetic appeal or as an item to sell off.

entries.name: Nettie's Gloves
entries.description: Nettie's Gloves are a common pair of Gloves belonging to the Druid Nettie. These gloves offer no benefits beyond cosmetic appeal or as an item to sell.

entries.name: Braindrain Gloves
entries.description: Braindrain Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that inflicts Mental Fatigue on a foe whenever the wearer deals ⁠Psychic damage to them.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Uncommon)
entries.description: The Dark Justiciar Gauntlets are an uncommon pair of Gloves that cause weapon attacks to deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Fleetfingers
entries.description: The Fleetfingers are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to Jump after using Dash without costing a bonus action.

entries.name: Gloves of Archery
entries.description: Gloves of Archery are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant the wearer Proficiency with Longbows and Shortbows, as well as +2 damage with ranged weapon attacks.

entries.name: Gloves of Baneful Striking
entries.description: The Gloves of Baneful Striking are an uncommon pair of Gloves. They apply a penalty to saving throws against the wearer's spells when previously struck by a weapon attack from the wearer.

entries.name: Gloves of Belligerent Skies
entries.description: The Gloves of Belligerent Skies are an uncommon pair of Gloves that inflict Reverberation when the wearer deals ⁠Thunder, ⁠Lightning or ⁠Radiant damage.

entries.name: Gloves of Hail of Thorns
entries.description: Gloves of Hail of Thorns are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grants the wearer the to ability to cast Hail of Thorns.

entries.name: Gloves of Heroism
entries.description: The Gloves of Heroism are an uncommon pair of gloves that grants their wearer Heroism whenever using Channel Oath spells.

entries.name: Gloves of Power
entries.description: Gloves of Power are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to inflict Bane on weapon attacks.

entries.name: Gloves of the Growling Underdog
entries.description: The Gloves of the Growling Underdog are an uncommon pair of Gloves which grant the wearer  Advantage on their melee attack rolls while surrounded by 2 or more enemies.

entries.name: Gloves of Thievery
entries.description: Gloves of Thievery are an uncommon pair of Gloves that give the wearer  Advantage on Sleight of Hand checks.

entries.name: Hellrider's Pride
entries.description: Hellrider's Pride are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant creatures healed by the wearer resistance to the physical damage of weapon attacks.[See: Bugs]

entries.name: Herbalist's Gloves
entries.description: The Herbalist's Gloves are an uncommon pair of gloves that cleanse poison from those healed by the wearer.

entries.name: Ichorous Gloves
entries.description: Ichorous Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that can inflict Noxious Fumes on targets that are dealt Acid damage.

entries.name: Knock Knuckle Gloves
entries.description: Knock Knuckle Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant the Knock spell and increase Sleight of Hand by 1.

entries.name: Luminous Gloves
entries.description: The Luminous Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that causes the wearer's Radiant damage to afflict struck foes with the Radiating Orb condition.

entries.name: Reason's Grasp
entries.description: Reason's Grasp are an uncommon pair of Gloves that give the wearer Temporary Hit Points if they choose to end their Rage.

entries.name: Thermoarcanic Gloves
entries.description: Thermoarcanic Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant the wearer 2 turns of Heat whenever they deal Fire damage.

entries.name: Unlucky Thief's Gloves
entries.description: Unlucky Thief's Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grants the wearer +2 to Sleight of Hand checks.

entries.name: Winter's Clutches
entries.description: The Winter's Clutches are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to inflict Encrusted with Frost on enemies whenever they deal Cold damage.

entries.name: Bracers of Defence
entries.description: Bracers of Defence are a rare pair of Gloves which increase the wearer's Armour Class by 2 when unarmoured and not holding a shield.

entries.name: Cerebral Citadel Gloves
entries.description: The Cerebral Citadel Gloves are rare gloves that provide a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws when the wearer Charms or Frightens a creature.

entries.name: Cindersnap Gloves
entries.description: Cindersnap Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant the spell Protection from Missiles.

entries.name: Craterflesh Gloves
entries.description: Craterflesh Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that deal additional Force damage on a Critical Hit.

entries.name: Daredevil Gloves
entries.description: Daredevil Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that enhance Spell Attack Rolls and enable casting spells without Disadvantage even when adjacent to an enemy.

entries.name: Dark Displacement Gloves
entries.description: Dark Displacement Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant their wearer +1 Sleight of Hand. They also give a +1 Attack Roll bonus when attacking with thrown weapons and swap positions with these targets if they fail a Dexterity Saving Throw.

entries.name: Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Rare)
entries.description: The Dark Justiciar Gauntlets are a rare pair of Gloves that cause weapon attacks to deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage. They also grant better Strength Saving Throws and allow the wearer to cast Beckoning Darkness once per turn.

entries.name: Flawed Helldusk Gloves
entries.description: Flawed Helldusk Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that grant +1d4⁠⁠Fire damage to weapon attacks. Unarmed attacks deal +1d4⁠⁠Necrotic damage and have a chance to inflict  Bleeding.

entries.name: Gloves of Battlemage's Power
entries.description: Gloves of Battlemage's Power is a rare pair of Gloves. They allow the wearer to gain Arcane Acuity whenever they hit a target with a spell or cantrip that uses a weapon.

entries.name: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle
entries.description: The Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle are a rare pair of Gloves that add Fire damage to the wearer's unarmed attacks and the ability to cast Scorching Ray once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Gloves of Crushing
entries.description: Gloves of Crushing are a rare pair of gloves that enhance unarmed attack rolls and grant bonus Bludgeoning damage to unarmed attacks.

entries.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
entries.description: Gloves of Missile Snaring is a rare pair of gloves that allow the wearer to use Missile Snaring to reduce incoming ranged damage as a Reaction.

entries.name: Gloves of the Automaton
entries.description: The Gloves of the Automaton are a rare pair of Gloves which, when activated, cause the wearer to be treated as a Construct and grant  Advantage on weapon attacks for 10 turns.

entries.name: Gloves of the Balanced Hands
entries.description: Gloves of the Balanced Hands are a rare pair of Gloves that add the wearer's Ability Modifier to damage when they make an attack with their off-hand weapon.

entries.name: Gloves of The Duellist
entries.description: Gloves of The Duellist are a rare pair of Gloves that enhance melee weapon Attack Rolls when the wearer only holds one weapon in their main hand.

entries.name: Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo
entries.description: Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo is a rare pair of gloves that deals additional damage with Throw and Improvised Weapon attacks.

entries.name: Jhannyl's Gloves
entries.description: Jhannyl's Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that let the wearer automatically cast Lesser Restoration on themselves when they become Blinded, Paralysed or Poisoned.

entries.name: Martial Exertion Gloves
entries.description: Martial Exertion Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to gain an additional attack and double their movement speed for one turn at the cost of taking some damage.

entries.name: Nimblefinger Gloves
entries.description: Nimblefinger Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant a Dexterity bonus to Gnomes, Halflings, and Dwarves, as well as a bonus to Sleight of Hand.

entries.name: Poisoner's Gloves
entries.description: Poisoner's Gloves are a rare set of Gloves. They afford their wearer a chance to poison a target (DC 13) every time it receives Poison damage.

entries.name: Raven Gloves
entries.description: Raven Gloves are rare Gloves that allow the wearer to summon a Raven.

entries.name: Seraphic Pugilist Gloves
entries.description: Seraphic Pugilist Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that give additional 1d4 Radiant damage to unarmed attacks and the ability to cast Guiding Bolt.

entries.name: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves
entries.description: The Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that give additional Force damage to unarmed attacks and allows the wearer to cast Fear once per Long Rest.
entries.wikiTitle: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves

entries.name: Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves
entries.description: Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that add an additional 1d4 Cold damage to the wearer's unarmed atacks. They also grant the ability to cast Ice Knife as a 3rd level spell once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Spellseeking Gloves
entries.description: Spellseeking Gloves are rare Gloves that allow the wearer to spend a Sorcery Point to gain Advantage when making a spell attack roll.

entries.name: Stalker Gloves
entries.description: Stalker Gloves are a rare pair of gloves which improve the wearer's sneak attacks and initiative.

entries.name: Swordmaster Gloves
entries.description: The Swordmaster Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves which grant proficiency with three types of swords and provide a bonus to melee Attack Rolls.

entries.name: The Sparkle Hands
entries.description: The Sparkle Hands are a pair of rare Gloves that grant Lightning Charges  on unarmed attacks and provide Advantage against metal constructs and armoured foes while charged.

entries.name: Thunderpalm Strikers
entries.description: The Thunderpalm Strikers are a rare pair of Gloves that add Thunder damage to unarmed attacks and allow the wearer to cast Thunderwave once per long rest.

entries.name: Winkling Gloves
entries.description: Winkling Gloves are a Rare pair of Gloves that improve the wearer's Attack Rolls and Sleight of Hand checks.

entries.name: Wondrous Gloves
entries.description: The Wondrous Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that increase the wearer's AC and give Bards an additional Bardic Inspiration.

entries.name: Abyss Beckoners
entries.description: The Abyss Beckoners are a very rare pair of gloves. They improve the damage resistance of the wearer's summons at the risk of driving them Mad.

entries.name: Bhaalist Gloves
entries.description: Bhaalist Gloves are a very rare pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to Garrotte a target.

entries.name: Bonespike Gloves
entries.description: Bonespike Gloves is a pair of very rare gloves. They allow the wearer's attacks to ignore Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Gauntlet of the Tyrant
entries.description: Gauntlet of the Tyrant is a very rare Glove. It grants +1 Spell Save DC and the ability to cast the Command spell. It also adds Force damage to the wearer's unarmed attacks.

entries.name: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength
entries.description: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength are a very rare pair of Gloves that set the wearer's Strength ability score to 23.

entries.name: Gemini Gloves
entries.description: The Gemini Gloves are a very rare pair of Gloves. They grant the wearer the ability to cast Cantrips which can target foes or allies twice.

entries.name: Gloves of Dexterity
entries.description: The Gloves of Dexterity are a very rare pair of gloves that give a character 18 Dexterity and increase their  Attack Rolls by 1.

entries.name: Helldusk Gloves
entries.description: Helldusk Gloves are a very rare pair of Gloves. They grant bonuses to spellcasting, weapon attacks, and unarmed attacks.

entries.name: Hr'a'cknir Bracers
entries.description: Hr'a'cknir Bracers is a very rare pair of Gloves that allows the wearer to cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action and cast Telekinesis once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Quickspell Gloves
entries.description: Quickspell Gloves are a pair of Very Rare Gloves that grant the wearer the ability to cast a Cantrip as a Bonus Action instead of an Action, once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Spellmight Gloves
entries.description: Spellmight Gloves are a pair of very rare Gloves that allow the wearer to deal additional damage at the cost of accuracy.

entries.name: Gloves of Soul Catching
entries.description: The Gloves of Soul Catching are a legendary pair of Gloves. They grant additional Force damage to unarmed attacks, +2 Constitution, and heal the wearer after an unarmed attack.

entries.name: Metallic Gloves
entries.description: Metallic Gloves are a common pair of Gloves.

entries.name: Metallic Gloves (Dream Guardian)
entries.description: Metallic Gloves are a common pair of Gloves.

entries.name: Blackguard's Gauntlets
entries.description: Blackguard's Gauntlets are a rare pair of Gauntlets that grant their wearer +1 to Attacks and Strength Saving Throws. They also allow their wearer to cast Inflict Wounds as a 4th level spell once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Gauntlets of Surging Accuracy
entries.description: Gauntlets of Surging Accuracy are a rare pair of gloves that give the wearer a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls for the rest of their turn when using Action Surge.

entries.name: Unwanted Masterwork Gauntlets
entries.description: Unwanted Masterwork Gauntlets are a rare pair of Gloves that provide a bonus to Attack Rolls and Strength Saving Throws. They are part of the Unwanted set.

entries.name: Gauntlets of the Warmaster
entries.description: Gauntlets of the Warmaster are a very rare pair of Gauntlets. They grant their wielder +1 on Attack Rolls and subject the targets of their Manoeuvres to Disadvantage.

entries.name: Legacy of the Masters
entries.description: The Legacy of the Masters are a very rare pair of Gloves that grant +2 to the wearer's attack and damage rolls.

entries.name: The Reviving Hands
entries.description: The Reviving Hands are a very rare pair of Gloves that grants the wearer the to ability to cast Revivify. They also apply Blade Ward and Death Ward to creatures healed or revived by the wearer respectively.

entries.name: Alfira's Lute
entries.description: Alfira's Lute is a unique instrument. It can be played with the Perform action.

entries.name: Battered Lute
entries.description: Battered Lute is a uniquely named lute that is part of a quest. It is otherwise identical to the common item variation, and can be used as such.

entries.name: Dostrealt's Piccolo
entries.description:
Dostrealt's Piccolo is a unique instrument.  It can be played with the Perform action.
This variant is functionally no different from the regular Flute.

entries.name: Falataeric Cli Lyre
entries.description:
Falataeric Cli Lyre is a unique instrument.  It can be played with the Perform action.
This variant is functionally no different from the regular Lyre.

entries.name: Flute
entries.description: Flute is a starting instrument for the Bard.  It can be played with the Perform action.

entries.name: Glimmergad's Selgaunt Fiddle
entries.description:
Glimmergad's Selgaunt Fiddle is a unique instrument.  It can be played with the Perform action.
This variant is functionally no different from the regular Violin.

entries.name: Hand Drum
entries.description: Hand Drum is a starting instrument for the Bard. It can be played with the Perform action.

entries.name: Kiam Goda's Kilat Drum
entries.description:
Kiam Goda's Kilat Drum is a unique instrument.  It can be played with the Perform action.
This variant is functionally no different from the regular Hand Drum.

entries.name: Lihala's Lute
entries.description: Lihala's Lute is a unique instrument.  It can be played with the Perform action.

entries.name: Lute
entries.description: Lute is a starting instrument for the Bard. It can be played with the Perform action.

entries.name: Lute of the Merryweather Bard
entries.description: Lute of the Merryweather Bard is an instrument that can be played using the Perform action.

entries.name: Lyre
entries.description: Lyre is a starting instrument for the Bard.  It can be played with the Perform action.

entries.name: Spider's Lyre
entries.description: Spider's Lyre is a quest item that is dropped by  Minthara and  Nere. The Lyre is used to summon a  guide in crossing through the Shadow-Cursed Lands to reach Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Stolyarof's Table Lute
entries.description:
Stolyarof's Table Lute is a unique instrument.  It can be played with the Perform action.
This variant is functionally no different from the other regular Lute variants.

entries.name: Violin
entries.description: Violin is a starting instrument for the Bard.  It can be played with the Perform action.

entries.name: 'Magic' Ring
entries.description: 'Magic' Ring is a common Ring which can be sold or bartered with.

entries.name: Amethyst Ring
entries.description: An Amethyst Ring is a common Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Bloody Signet Ring
entries.description: Bloody Signet Ring is a common Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Bronze Ring
entries.description: A Bronze Ring describes a variety of common Ring, primarily of value for use in trading or bartering with vendors.

entries.name: Carnelian Ring
entries.description: An Carnelian Ring is a common Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Copper Band
entries.description: A Copper Band is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Copper Ring
entries.description: Copper Ring is a common Ring that can be sold for Gold or bartered to a Merchant.

entries.name: Dark Ring
entries.description: A Dark Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Dowry Ring
entries.description: A Dowry Ring is a common type of Ring. It can be sold or bartered with, but it is better used to complete ⁠Rescue the Trapped Man by giving it to  Benryn.

entries.name: Emerald Ring
entries.description: An Emerald Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Garnet Ring
entries.description: A Garnet Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Gold Band
entries.description: A Gold Band is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Gold Ring
entries.description: A Gold Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Onyx Ring
entries.description: Onyx Ring is a Ring that can be sold for Gold or bartered to a Merchant.

entries.name: Peridot Ring
entries.description: A Peridot Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Polished Ring
entries.description: A Polished Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Ring of Being Really Invisible
entries.description: A Ring of Being Really Invisible is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Ring of Infinite Wishes
entries.description: A Ring of Infinite Wishes is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Ring of Murderous Opportunity
entries.description: The Ring of Murderous Opportunity is a unique Ring.

entries.name: Ring of Resistance to Ants
entries.description: A Ring of Resistance to Ants is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Ring of the Lekinesus
entries.description: A Ring of the Lekinesus is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Ruby Ring
entries.description: Ruby Ring is a common Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Silver Band
entries.description: Silver Band is a Ring that can be sold for Gold or bartered to a Merchant.

entries.name: Tarnished Ring
entries.description: The Tarnished Ring is a common Ring belonging to  Derryth Bonecloak.

entries.name: Tarnished Wedding Ring
entries.description: Tarnished Wedding Ring is a common Ring. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Tourmaline Ring
entries.description: A Tourmaline Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Verdelite Ring
entries.description: Verdelite Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.

entries.name: Bracing Band
entries.description: The Bracing Band is an uncommon Ring which makes the wearer more difficult to hit after they shove an enemy.

entries.name: Callous Glow Ring
entries.description: Callous Glow Ring is an uncommon Ring that deals an additional 2 Radiant damage whenever the wearer deals damage to illuminated creatures.

entries.name: Caustic Band
entries.description: Caustic Band is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer 2 Acid damage with weapon attacks.

entries.name: Coruscation Ring
entries.description: Coruscation Ring is an uncommon ring that inflicts  Radiating Orb on creatures that the wearer deals spell damage to. The wearer must be illuminated for this effect to occur.

entries.name: Crusher's Ring
entries.description: Crusher's Ring is an uncommon Ring which grants additional speed to the wearer.

entries.name: Djinni Ring
entries.description: Djinni Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast Mage Hand.

entries.name: Eversight Ring
entries.description: Eversight Ring is an uncommon Ring that imparts immunity to  Blindness upon the wearer.

entries.name: Explorer's Ring
entries.description: The Explorer's Ring is an uncommon Ring that improves the wearer's knowledge of Nature and Survival.

entries.name: Family Ring
entries.description: The Family Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants +2 to Death Saving Throws.

entries.name: Firzu's Ring of Trading
entries.description: Firzu's Ring of Trading is an uncommon Ring that grants +1 to Deception.

entries.name: Guild Ring
entries.description: Guild Ring is a story-related Ring found in Act 3.

entries.name: Mage's Friend
entries.description: Mage's Friend is an uncommon Ring that improves the wearer's knowledge of Arcana and Religion.

entries.name: Poisoner's Ring
entries.description: The Poisoner's Ring is an uncommon Ring which allows the wearer to cast Virulent Venom.

entries.name: Ring of Absolute Force
entries.description: The Ring of Absolute Force is an uncommon Ring. It allows the wearer to cast the  Thunderwave spell and deal 1 additional thunder damage if they have the Absolute's Brand.[See: Bugs]

entries.name: Ring of Colour Spray
entries.description: Ring of Colour Spray is an uncommon Ring which allows the wearer to cast  Colour Spray once per short rest.

entries.name: Ring of Elemental Infusion
entries.description: The Ring of Elemental Infusion is an uncommon Ring that infuses your weapon with the element of your spells or cantrips, dealing additional damage.

entries.name: Ring of Flinging
entries.description: Ring of Flinging is an uncommon Ring that improves throwing damage.

entries.name: Ring of Geniality
entries.description: Ring of Geniality is an uncommon Ring that grants a boost to Persuasion and Deception.

entries.name: Ring of Jumping
entries.description: Ring of Jumping is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast Enhance Leap once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Ring of Mental Inhibition
entries.description: Ring of Mental Inhibition is an uncommon Ring that places a mentally weakening condition on enemies who fail to Save against the wearer's spells and abilities.

entries.name: Ring of Salving
entries.description: The Ring of Salving is an uncommon Ring which restores additional hit points every time the wearer heals another creature.

entries.name: Ring of Self Immolation
entries.description: The Ring of Self Immolation is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to use the Self Immolation ability to gain the  Heat condition.

entries.name: Ring of Shadows
entries.description: The Ring of Shadows is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast  Pass Without Trace once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Ring of Spiteful Thunder
entries.description: The Ring of Spiteful Thunder is a uncommon Ring that may  Daze Reverberating creatures upon which the wearer deals ⁠Thunder damage.

entries.name: Seemingly Gleaming Ring
entries.description: Seemingly Gleaming Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants +1 to Charisma Saving Throws and a -1 to Wisdom Saving Throws.

entries.name: Shadow Blade Ring
entries.description: Shadow Blade Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast Shadow Blade. It is a reward for completing the quest Find Arabella's Parents.

entries.name: Shadow-Cloaked Ring
entries.description: The Shadow-Cloaked Ring is an uncommon Ring that causes the wearer's weapon and unarmed attacks to deal an additional 1d4 damage against Obscured or shadow creatures.

entries.name: Shapeshifter's Boon Ring
entries.description: Shapeshifter's Boon Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer +1d4 on all checks made while shapeshifted or disguised.

entries.name: Smuggler's Ring
entries.description: Smuggler's Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer bonuses to Stealth and Sleight of Hand.

entries.name: Snowburst Ring
entries.description: Snowburst Ring is an uncommon Ring that causes the wearer to create a 4.5m / 15ft circle of ice around their target when dealing Cold damage.

entries.name: Spurred Band
entries.description: The Spurred Band is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer Momentum while greatly injured.

entries.name: Strange Conduit Ring
entries.description: The Strange Conduit Ring is a uncommon Ring that grants additional Psychic damage to the wearer's weapon while Concentrating.

entries.name: Sunwalker's Gift
entries.description: Sunwalker's Gift is an uncommon Ring that grants a creature darkvision.

entries.name: The Sparkswall
entries.description: The Sparkswall is an uncommon Ring that shields the wearer from Lightning.

entries.name: The Whispering Promise
entries.description: The Whispering Promise is an uncommon Ring that grants a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws to creatures healed by the wearer.

entries.name: After Death Do Us Part
entries.description: After Death Do Us Part is a rare Ring which allows its wearer to regain half their hit points after being  Downed, but be cursed with  Shadow Possession.[See: Bugs]

entries.name: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel
entries.description: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel is a rare Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast illusion or enchantment spells as a bonus action after hitting a creature with a weapon attack.

entries.name: Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands
entries.description: The Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands is a rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast the Invisibility spell once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Keepsake Ring
entries.description: Keepsake Ring is a rare Ring that allows its wearer to cast  Dominate Beast as a 5th level spell once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Ring of Arcane Synergy
entries.description: Ring of Arcane Synergy is a rare Ring. It grants Arcane Synergy when the wearer deals damage with a cantrip.

entries.name: Ring of Blink
entries.description: The Ring of Blink is a rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast  Blink once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Ring of Exalted Marrow
entries.description: Ring of Exalted Marrow is a rare Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast Exhort the Risen and Ghoulish Touch.

entries.name: Ring of Free Action
entries.description: Ring of Free Action is a rare Ring which allows the wearer to ignore the effects of Difficult Terrain and confers immunity to  Paralysis and being  Restrained.

entries.name: Ring of Mind-Shielding
entries.description: The Ring of Mind-Shielding is a rare Ring that gives advantage on saving throws against being Charmed.

entries.name: Ring of Poison Resistance
entries.description: The Ring of Poison Resistance is a rare Ring that grants the wearer Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.

entries.name: Ring of Protection
entries.description: The Ring of Protection is a rare Ring that grants the wearer a bonus to  Armour Class and  Saving Throws.

entries.name: Ring of Truthfulness
entries.description: Ring of Truthfulness is a rare ring that grants its wearer  Advantage on  Insight Checks.

entries.name: Ring of Twilight
entries.description: The Ring of Twilight is a rare Ring that increases the wearer's Armour Class while obscured.

entries.name: Risky Ring
entries.description: The Risky Ring is a rare Ring. The wearer gains  Advantage on  Attack Rolls but receives  Disadvantage on  Saving Throws.

entries.name: Shifting Corpus Ring
entries.description: The Shifting Corpus Ring is a rare Ring that grants the ability to cast Invisibility  and Blur once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Till Death Do Us Part
entries.description: Til Death Do Us Part is a rare Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast  Beacon of Hope.

entries.name: True Love's Caress
entries.description: True Love's Caress is one of a matching pair of Rings that grants the wearer  Warding Bond.

entries.name: True Love's Embrace
entries.description: True Love's Embrace is one of a matching pair of Rings that lets the wearer cast  Warding Bond.

entries.name: Burnished Ring
entries.description: The Burnished Ring is a very rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast  Paralyzing Ray once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Crypt Lord Ring
entries.description: Crypt Lord Ring is a very rare Ring. It allows the wearer to cast  Create Undead once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Killer's Sweetheart
entries.description: Killer's Sweetheart is a very rare Ring that makes the wearer's next Attack Roll a critical hit after killing a creature, once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Orphic Ring
entries.description: Orphic Ring is a very rare ring that grants its wearer the  Confusion (level 5) spell on a long rest cooldown.

entries.name: Ring of Evasion
entries.description: Ring of Evasion is a very rare Ring that grants the wearer Dextrous Evasion.

entries.name: Ring of Feywild Sparks
entries.description: Ring of Feywild Sparks is a very rare Ring. It forces Wild Magic Surges to always trigger while  Tides of Chaos feature is active. It also grants a +1 bonus to  Spell Save DC.

entries.name: Ring of Regeneration
entries.description: Ring of Regeneration is a very rare Ring that heals the wearer at the beginning of their turn while in combat.

entries.name: Guiding Light
entries.description: The Guiding Light is a story-related Ring that allows the wearer to cast the  Light cantrip.

entries.name: Szarr Family Ring
entries.description: Szarr Family Ring is a story-related Ring that opens several doors in the Szarr Palace and Cazador's Dungeon.

entries.name: A Sparking Promise
entries.description: A Sparking Promise is a rare Ring. It grants a cantrip which can electrify surfaces the target walks on.

entries.name: Absolute's Smite
entries.description: Absolute's Smite is an inaccessible uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast Searing Smite once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Hag's Ring
entries.description: Hag's Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer access to Vicious Mockery

entries.name: Ring of Beguiling
entries.description: The Ring of Beguiling is an inaccessible rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast the  Charm Person spell once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Ring of Crabsight
entries.description: Ring of Crabsight is an uncommon Ring that grants +2 Perception.

entries.name: Ring of Fire
entries.description: The Ring of Fire is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer additional fire damage when dealing fire damage.

entries.name: Ring of Restorative Gravity
entries.description: The Ring of Restorative Gravity is an uncommon Ring that pulls creatures towards the wearer when healed by them.

entries.name: Sandthief's Ring
entries.description: The Sandthief's Ring is an inaccessible uncommon Ring that allows the wearer to cast the  Invisibility spell once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Broken Shield
entries.description: The Broken Shield is a common Shield that is severly damaged, providing less AC than regular shields.

entries.name: Fossilised Shell
entries.description: The Fossilised Shell is a common Shield worn by the primitive kuo-toa of the Underdark.

entries.name: Iron-Banded Shield
entries.description: The Iron-Banded Shield is a common Shield.

entries.name: Metal Shield
entries.description: The Metal Shield is a common Shield emblazoned with the symbol of the Flaming Fist mercenaries.

entries.name: Organic Shield
entries.description: An Organic Shield is a common Shield.

entries.name: Rusty Studded Shield
entries.description: The Rusty Studded Shield is a common Shield.

entries.name: Scrapwood Shield
entries.description: A Scrapwood Shield is a common Shield used by goblins.

entries.name: Shield (item)
entries.description: A Shield is a common piece of defensive equipment wielded in one hand.

entries.name: Spiked Shield
entries.description: A Spiked Shield is a common Shield used by Goblins.

entries.name: Studded Shield
entries.description: A Studded Shield is a common Shield.

entries.name: Training Shield
entries.description: The Training Shield is a common Shield that is reserved for practice instead of real fighting. Considering it isn't sold anywhere, requires stealing and is inferior to other shields it can be considered little more than junk.

entries.name: Wooden Shield
entries.description: A Wooden Shield is a common Shield.

entries.name: Absolute's Warboard
entries.description: Absolute's Warboard is an uncommon Shield that improves a branded wearer's Saving Throws and allows them to cast Heroism once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Gloomstrand Shield
entries.description: Gloomstrand Shield is an uncommon Shield that adds +1 to Stealth

entries.name: Glowing Shield
entries.description: The Glowing Shield is an uncommon Shield that grants its user Temporary Hit Points once per Short Rest when they take damage while greatly injured.

entries.name: Ironvine Shield
entries.description: Ironvine Shield is an uncommon Shield that damages the attacker if the wielder is using a weapon empowered with Shillelagh.

entries.name: Safeguard Shield
entries.description: The Safeguard Shield is an uncommon Shield that grants you Saving Throws +1

entries.name: The Real Sparky Sparkswall
entries.description: The Real Sparky Sparkswall is an uncommon Shield that allows the wearer to create a Lightning Aura.

entries.name: Watcher's Shield
entries.description: Watcher's Shield is an uncommon Shield that gives the wielder Advantage on Perception Checks.

entries.name: Wood Woad Shield
entries.description: Wood Woad Shield is an uncommon Shield found on Wood Woads and grants its wearer the ability to cast Woad's Ensnaring Strike.

entries.name: Absolute's Protector
entries.description: Absolute's Protector is a rare Shield that reduces damage from spells by 1 if the user bears the mark of the Absolute, grants Shield Bash, and allows the wielder to cast Fire Shield: Chill once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Adamantine Shield
entries.description: Adamantine Shield is a rare Shield that sends enemies Reeling when they miss you with a melee attack.

entries.name: Iron-Banded Shield +1
entries.description: Iron-Banded Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its Armour Class bonus.

entries.name: Justiciar's Greatshield
entries.description: Justiciar's Greatshield is a rare Shield that allows the wielder to cast Darkness Cloak to hide themselves, and gains advantage on Perception checks.

entries.name: Ketheric's Shield
entries.description: Ketheric's Shield is a rare Shield. It grants the Shield Bash action, improves the wielder's spellcasting-related rolls, and also gives them Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

entries.name: Sentinel Shield
entries.description: Sentinel Shield is a rare Shield that provides the user +3 to Initiative rolls and advantage on Perception checks

entries.name: Shield +1
entries.description: A Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its  Armour Class bonus.

entries.name: Shield of Scorching Reprisal
entries.description: Shield of Scorching Reprisal is a rare Shield that grants Fire Resistance, allows one to Shield Bash, and also apply Blazing Retaliation.

entries.name: Shield of Shielding
entries.description: Shield of Shielding is a rare Shield that allows the wearer to cast Shield and use Shield Bash.

entries.name: Studded Shield +1
entries.description: A Studded Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its  Armour Class bonus.

entries.name: Abdel's Trusted Shield
entries.description: Abdel's Trusted Shield is a very rare Shield that allows the wearer to cast Protection from Missiles once per Short Rest, as well as use Shield Bash.

entries.name: Shield of Devotion
entries.description: Shield of Devotion is a very rare Shield that grants a Level 1 Spell Slot, Shield Bash, and allows the wielder to cast Shield of Devotion: Aid at Level 3 Spell once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Shield of the Undevout
entries.description: Shield of the Undevout is a very rare Shield that applies Disadvantage on Frightened Saving Throws to your foes and grants an additional level 1 spell slot. It also grants Shield Bash.

entries.name: Swires' Sledboard
entries.description: Swires' Sledboard is a very rare shield that grants the wearer Force Conduit at the start of combat. It also grants Shield Bash.

entries.name: Viconia's Walking Fortress
entries.description: Viconia's Walking Fortress is a legendary shield that can deal Force damage to the attacker when hit. Gives Advantage on saving throws against spells and Disadvantage to spell attacks made against the wearer.

entries.name: Astarion's Underwear
entries.description: Astarions's Underwear is common Underwear.

entries.name: Halsin's Underwear
entries.description: Halsin's Underwear are common Underwear.

entries.name: Jaheira's Underwear
entries.description: Jaheira's Underwear are common Underwear.

entries.name: Karlach's Underwear
entries.description: Karlach's Underwear is the default Underwear for Karlach.

entries.name: Lae'zel's Underwear
entries.description: Lae'zel's Underwear is a common Underwear. According to Lae'zel, the under-harnesses are used for strapping oneself onto a red dragon.

entries.name: Minthara's Underwear
entries.description: Minthara's Underwear are a common Underwear.

entries.name: Netherese Briefs
entries.description: Netherese Briefs are common underwear.

entries.name: Periwinkle Undergarments
entries.description: Periwinkle Undergarments are common Underwear.

entries.name: Shadowheart's Underwear
entries.description: Shadowheart's Underwear is a common Underwear.

entries.name: Underwear
entries.description: Underwear is a common pair of Underwear.

entries.name: Wyll's Underwear
entries.description: Wyll's Underwear is the default Underwear for Wyll.

entries.name: Artificial Leech
entries.description: Artificial Leech is a common variant of the Daggers family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.  Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.

entries.name: Battle-Worn Blade
entries.description: Battle-Worn Blade is a common variant of the Longswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Battleaxe
entries.description: Battleaxe is a common variant of the Battleaxes family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Bonesaw
entries.description: Bonesaw is a common variant of the Longswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: BOOOAL's Arms
entries.description: BOOOAL's Arms is a common variant of the Javelins family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand.    Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.

entries.name: Broken Pike
entries.description: Broken Pike is a common variant of the Pikes family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that's wielded with both hands.   It gives the user extra reach in melee combat.

entries.name: Cemetery-Blue Torch
entries.description: The Cemetery-Blue Torch can be used as a Light Source or as an improvised club. It can be wielded as a simple melee weapon in one hand. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual wield without special training. It can ignite flammable surfaces or clouds if it makes contact.

entries.name: Cleaver
entries.description: Cleaver is a common variant of the Handaxes family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand.

entries.name: Club
entries.description: Club is a mundane, nonmagical variant of the Clubs family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training. It is more or less a temporary weapon considering other simple weapons like Mace are superior to it in damage.

entries.name: Crude Mace
