entries.description: Kurwin's Cauteriser is an uncommon +1 Scimitar that deals extra Fire damage on hit, and possibly Burns the target as well.

entries.name: Light Hammer +1
entries.description: Light Hammer +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Light Hammers family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand.  It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.  Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.

entries.name: Light of Creation
entries.description: Light of Creation is an uncommon +1 Halberd that deals additional Lightning damage, but has a chance to Stun its wielder on each successful attack.

entries.name: Lightning Jabber
entries.description: Lightning Jabber is an uncommon +1 Spear that deals extra Lightning damage when thrown, and also has a chance to  Shock a target on hit.

entries.name: Longsword +1
entries.description: Longsword +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Longswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Loviatar's Scourge
entries.description: Loviatar's Scourge is an uncommon Mace that grants the wielder resistance to Necrotic damage. It also deals additional Necrotic damage to all nearby creatures, including the wielder.

entries.name: Mace +1
entries.description: Mace +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Maces family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand.

entries.name: Magical Pike
entries.description: Magical Pike is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Pikes family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that's wielded with both hands.   It gives the user extra reach in melee combat.

entries.name: Maul +1
entries.description: Maul +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Maul.

entries.name: Melf's First Staff
entries.description: The Melf's First Staff is an uncommon +1 Quarterstaff that improves Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls, and allows the wearer to cast Melf's Acid Arrow.

entries.name: Merregon Halberd
entries.description: Merregon Halberd is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Halberd.

entries.name: Morningstar +1
entries.description: Morningstar +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Morningstars family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand.

entries.name: Murderous Cut
entries.description: Murderous Cut is an uncommon +1 Dagger that deals extra Piercing damage to targets with less than half their maximum Hit points.

entries.name: Myrkulite Scourge
entries.description: Myrkulite Scourge is an uncommon +1 Flail that deals an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage on a strike.

entries.name: Nature's Snare
entries.description: Nature's Snare is a variant of the Quarterstaves family of weapons that gives its wielder a chance to Ensnare non-plants and non-beasts on hit.

entries.name: Pike +1
entries.description: Pike +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Pikes family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that's wielded with both hands.   It gives the user extra reach in melee combat.

entries.name: Quarterstaff +1
entries.description: Quarterstaff +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Quarterstaves family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Rain Dancer
entries.description: Rain Dancer is an uncommon Quarterstaff that grants the wielder the ability to cast Create Water, once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Rapier +1
entries.description: Rapier +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Rapiers family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength.

entries.name: Render of Mind and Body
entries.description: Render of Mind and Body is an uncommon +1 Shortsword that deals additional Psychic damage whenever the attack is made at Advantage.

entries.name: Returning Pike
entries.description: Returning Pike is an uncommon +1 Pike that returns to the wielder automatically after being thrown.

entries.name: Ritual Axe
entries.description: Ritual Axe is an uncommon Handaxe which inflicts  Bane against the wielder's targets.

entries.name: Ritual Dagger
entries.description: Ritual Dagger is an uncommon dagger that temporarily Blesses the wielder when dealing damage to an enemy - or to themselves.

entries.name: Ritual Dagger of Shar
entries.description: Ritual Dagger of Shar is an uncommon +1 Dagger that deals an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Rupturing Blade
entries.description: Rupturing Blade is an uncommon +1 Rapier that grants the  Searing Blood weapon action that deals extra Fire damage on hit, but deals Slashing damage to the wielder. In addition, it also may cause Bleeding and Burning.

entries.name: Scimitar +1
entries.description: Scimitar +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Scimitars family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.

entries.name: Shadow Blade (weapon)
entries.description: Shadow Blade is an uncommon Shortsword which grants the wielder advantage against Lightly or Heavily Obscured targets when using this blade. It also deals 2d8 Psychic damage instead of the usual 1d6.

entries.name: Shining Staver-of-Skulls
entries.description: Shining Staver-of-Skulls is an uncommon +1 Light Hammer that sheds light in a radius around the wielder.

entries.name: Shortsword +1
entries.description: Shortsword +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Shortswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.

entries.name: Shortsword of First Blood
entries.description: The Shortsword of First Blood is an uncommon Shortsword. It deals more damage to enemies who have not been injured yet.

entries.name: Skybreaker
entries.description: Skybreaker is an uncommon +1 Light Hammer that grants the wielder the spell Searing Smite.

entries.name: Spear +1
entries.description: Spear +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Spears family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.    Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.

entries.name: Speedy Reply
entries.description: Speedy Reply is an uncommon Scimitar that grants the wielder 2 turns of  Momentum whenever they hit an enemy.

entries.name: Staff of a Mumbling Wizard
entries.description: Staff of a Mumbling Wizard is a Quarterstaff that allows the user to cast a variant of Fire Bolt that has a chance to cast Fireball instead.

entries.name: Staff of Arcane Blessing
entries.description: Staff of Arcane Blessing is an uncommon Quarterstaff which grants the wielder the ability to cast Bless. In addition, all Bless spells cast by the wielder grant an additional +1d4 to spell attack rolls.

entries.name: Staff of Crones
entries.description: Staff of Crones is a Quarterstaff and Story Item. It grants the wielder the ability to cast Ray of Sickness, once per Short Rest.

entries.name: Steelforged Sword
entries.description: Steelforged Sword is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Shortswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.

entries.name: Svartlebee's Woundseeker
entries.description: Svartlebee's Woundseeker is an uncommon +1 greatsword that grants its wielder bonus to Attack Rolls against already damaged creatures.

entries.name: Sword of Justice
entries.description: Sword of Justice is an uncommon +1 greatsword that grants its wielder the  Tyr's Protection spell.

entries.name: Sword of Screams
entries.description: Sword of Screams is an uncommon Rapier that deals an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.

entries.name: Sylvan Scimitar
entries.description: Sylvan Scimitar is an uncommon +1 Scimitar that allows its wielder to use their Spellcasting Ability modifier instead of their Dexterity modifier to determine their Attack Roll bonus.

entries.name: Syringe (+1)
entries.description: Syringe is an uncommon +1 Dagger which grants the Inject Nostrum weapon action to non player characters only.

entries.name: The Skinburster
entries.description: The Skinburster is an uncommon +1 Halberd that grants its wielder  Force Conduit on each successful hit.

entries.name: The Undead Bane
entries.description: The Undead Bane is an uncommon +1 Greataxe that deals additional Slashing damage against Fiends and Undead and grants its wielder the Profane Scourge weapon action.

entries.name: The Watcher's Guide
entries.description: The Watcher's Guide is an uncommon Spear that increases the chance to hit a target after the wielder misses it.

entries.name: Trepan (+1)
entries.description: Trepan is an uncommon +1 Shortsword which grants the weapon action Trephination to non player characters only.

entries.name: Trident +1
entries.description: Trident +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Tridents family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.    Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.

entries.name: Very Heavy Greataxe
entries.description: Very Heavy Greataxe is an uncommon +1 Greataxe. It grants its wielder the Gargantuan Cleave weapon action, which can strike multiple targets but leaves the wielder Off-Balance for 1 turn.

entries.name: Vision of the Absolute
entries.description: Vision of the Absolute is a Spear that possibly blinds targets and deals additional Piercing damage against targets with multiple sets of eyes.

entries.name: War Pick +1
entries.description: War Pick +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the War Picks family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand.

entries.name: Warhammer +1
entries.description: Warhammer +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Warhammers family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Witchbreaker
entries.description: Witchbreaker is an uncommon +1 Battleaxe that grants Advantage against concentrating foes and has a unique weapon action, Hush You!.

entries.name: Worgfang
entries.description: Worgfang is an uncommon dagger which grants the wielder defensive capabilities against Goblins.  Any goblin attacking the wielder suffers  Disadvantage on its Attack Rolls.

entries.name: Wulbren's Hammer
entries.description: Wulbren's Hammer is an uncommon +1 Light Hammer that deals an extra 2d4 Force damage on each hit against constructs and world objects.

entries.name: Xyanyde
entries.description: Xyanyde is an uncommon +1 Mace. Once per short rest, it applies Faerie Fire on targets that the wielder misses.

entries.name: Adamantine Longsword
entries.description: Adamantine Longsword is a rare +1 longsword that automatically critical hits objects and ignores resistance to ⁠Slashing damage.

entries.name: Adamantine Mace
entries.description: Adamantine Mace is a rare +1 Mace that automatically critical hits objects and ignores Resistance to Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Adamantine Scimitar
entries.description: Adamantine Scimitar is a rare +1 scimitar that automatically critical hits objects and ignores resistance to ⁠Slashing damage.

entries.name: Ambusher
entries.description: Ambusher is a rare +1 Shortsword that grants the wielder bonuses to Initiative and  Advantage on Perception checks; it also deals extra Necrotic damage on creatures which have not taken a turn yet.

entries.name: Bigboy's Chew Toy
entries.description: Bigboy's Chew Toy is a rare +1 Quarterstaff that grants its wielder the ability to cast Enlarge on themselves once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Blackguard's Sword
entries.description: Blackguard's Sword is a rare +2 Longsword that possibly  Dazes targets that have been Smited by the wielder.

entries.name: Blade of Oppressed Souls
entries.description: Blade of Oppressed Souls is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Longswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Blooded Greataxe
entries.description: Blooded Greataxe is a rare +1 Greataxe that deals additional Slashing damage when the wielder has 50% hit points or less.

entries.name: Breaching Pikestaff
entries.description: Breaching Pikestaff is a rare +2 Pike that deals an additional 1d4 Force on each successful hit.

entries.name: Cacophony
entries.description: Cacophony is a rare +1 Quarterstaff that grants the wielder the Thunderous Smite spell.

entries.name: Caitiff Staff
entries.description: Caitiff Staff is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) special variant of the Quarterstaves family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Charge-Bound Warhammer
entries.description:
Charge-Bound Warhammer is a rare +1 Warhammer with +1 bonus to damage and Attack Rolls, and deals additional 1d6⁠⁠Lightning damage.
This hammer's magical powers only function if it's  Bound to an Eldritch Knight or is a Warlock's  Pact Weapon.

entries.name: Clown Hammer
entries.description: Clown Hammer is a rare +2 Warhammer that forces both the wielder and the target to make a Wisdom Saving Throw on a critical hit, or else fall down laughing.

entries.name: Cold Snap
entries.description: Cold Snap is a rare Dagger which chills enemies that attack and miss the wielder; it also increases the wielder's Armour Class if used in the off-hand.

entries.name: Corpsegrinder
entries.description: Corpsegrinder is a rare +2 Maul that deals additional Thunder damage and grants its wielder the Grand Slam weapon action.

entries.name: Corrosive Flail
entries.description: Corrosive Flail is a rare +1 Flail that grants a special weapon action, Corrosive Strike.

entries.name: Creation's Echo
entries.description: Creation's Echo is a rare Quarterstaff that grants the wielder resistance to Acid, Fire, Lightning, Radiant, or Necrotic damage after first dealing damage of that element.

entries.name: Cruel Sting
entries.description: Cruel Sting is a rare +1 Longsword that deals extra Poison damage against  Restrained targets if the wielder is a drow elf. It also grants the  Ensnaring Strands spell.

entries.name: Dagger +2
entries.description: Dagger +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Daggers family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.  Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.

entries.name: Defender Flail
entries.description: The Defender Flail is a rare +1 Flail that reduces physical weapon damage to the wearer and increases Armour Class.

entries.name: Defender Greataxe
entries.description: Defender Greataxe is a rare +2 Greataxe that can be reduced in its enchantment on the first attack of the round to increase wielder's Armour Class and saving throw bonus.

entries.name: Despair of Athkatla
entries.description: Despair of Athkatla is a rare +2 Quarterstaff that enhances the wielder's spells.

entries.name: Dolor Amarus
entries.description: Dolor Amarus is a rare +2 dagger that deals 7 additional damage on a critical hit.

entries.name: Drakethroat Glaive
entries.description: Drakethroat Glaive is a rare +2 Glaive that grants its wielder the Draconic Elemental Weapon weapon action and a bonus to Dragonborn breath racial actions.

entries.name: Dread Iron Dagger
entries.description: Dread Iron Dagger is a rare +1 Dagger that deals extra Necrotic damage while the wielder is Hidden.

entries.name: Duke Ravengard's Longsword
entries.description: Duke Ravengard's Longsword is a rare +1 Longsword which increases the wielder's Charisma by +2 and can also grant allies temporary hit points based on their respective Charisma modifiers.

entries.name: Flail +2
entries.description: Flail +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Flails family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand.

entries.name: Flail of Ages
entries.description: Flail of Ages is a rare +1 Flail that applies variable conditions depending on what type of damage the flail does.

entries.name: Fleshrender
entries.description: Fleshrender is a rare +2 Shortsword that allows the wielder to make a diabolical strike, possibly stymying their target's ability to heal.

entries.name: Glaive +2
entries.description: Glaive +2 is a rare, enchanted (+2) Glaive.

entries.name: Gleamdance Dagger
entries.description: Gleamdance Dagger is a rare +2 Dagger that sheds light in a radius and increases the wielder's Armour Class if equipped in their off-hand.

entries.name: Gold Wyrmling Staff
entries.description: Gold Wyrmling Staff is a rare +1 Quarterstaff that deals additional Fire damage with melee strikes and grants its wielder the Fire Bolt cantrip.

entries.name: Greataxe +2
entries.description: Greataxe +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) Greataxe.

entries.name: Hammer of the Just
entries.description: Hammer of the Just is a rare +2 Warhammer which allows the wielder to cast Detect Thoughts and deals additional Radiant damage. It also deals additional Bludgeoning damage to Fiends and Undead.

entries.name: Harmonic Dueller
entries.description: Harmonic Dueller is a rare +1 Rapier that when activated, can grant all the wielder's melee attacks extra damage equal to their Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Harmonium Halberd
entries.description: Harmonium Halberd is a rare +1 Halberd that grants its wielder additional Strength at the cost of some Intelligence and Wisdom.

entries.name: Harper Sacredstriker
entries.description: Harper Sacredstriker is a rare +1 Quarterstaff that grants the wielder the Spiritual Weapon spell at level 6.

entries.name: Hellbeard Halberd
entries.description: Hellbeard Halberd is a rare +2 Halberd which deals additional ⁠Poison damage and possibly  Poisons the target.

entries.name: Hollow's Staff
entries.description: Hollow's Staff is a rare +1 Quarterstaff which makes it difficult for enemies to resist the wielder's spells, and grants the wielder the Arms of Hadar spell.

entries.name: Infernal Mace
entries.description: Infernal Mace is a rare +2 Mace which deals an extra 3 Poison damage and possibly Poisons the target on a hit.

entries.name: Infernal Spear
entries.description: Infernal Spear is a rare +1 Spear that deals an extra 3 Poison damage and possibly Poisons the target on a hit.

entries.name: Jorgoral's Greatsword
entries.description: Jorgoral's Greatsword is a rare +1 greatsword that grants its wielder the Colossal Onslaught weapon action.

entries.name: Ketheric's Warhammer
entries.description: Ketheric's Warhammer is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Warhammers family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Larethian's Wrath
entries.description: Larethian's Wrath is a rare +1 Longsword that grants the wielder the Razor Gale weapon action, and is a Finesse weapon, unlike most Longswords.

entries.name: Longsword +2
entries.description: Longsword +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Longswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Mace +2
entries.description: Mace +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Maces family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand.

entries.name: Monster Slayer Glaive
entries.description: Monster Slayer Glaive is a rare +1 Glaive that deals additional damage against Monstrosities and increases its wielder's Jump distance.

entries.name: Moonlight Glaive
entries.description: Moonlight Glaive is a rare +2 Glaive that deals additional Radiant damage, has a permanent Light effect, and grants its wielder the Moonlight Butterflies weapon action.

entries.name: Pale Oak
entries.description: Pale Oak is a rare Quarterstaff that grants the Faithwarden's Vines spell and prevents the wielder from being Ensnared by vines.

entries.name: Phalar Aluve
entries.description: Phalar Aluve is a rare +1 Longsword that can be made to  Sing or  Shriek, granting nearby allies or enemies a bonus to Attack Rolls or damage rolls, depending on the choice.

entries.name: Punch-Drunk Bastard
entries.description: Punch-Drunk Bastard is a rare +1 Greatclub. While the wielder is  drunk it grants them  Advantage on weapon attacks[See: Bugs] and also creates a ⁠Thunder blast on each melee hit.

entries.name: Quarterstaff +2
entries.description: Quarterstaff +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Quarterstaves family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Rapier +2
entries.description: Rapier +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Rapiers family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength.

entries.name: Rat Bat
entries.description: The Rat Bat is a rare Greatclub that grants the wielder Advantage on their Attack Rolls against beasts.

entries.name: Ravengard's Scourger
entries.description: Ravengard's Scourger is a rare +2 Morningstar that allows the wielder to cast Commander's Strike.

entries.name: Salty Scimitar(rrr)
entries.description: Salty Scimitar(rrr) is a rare +2 Scimitar that allows the wielder to cast  Command once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Scimitar +2
entries.description: Scimitar +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Scimitars family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.

entries.name: Shadow Lantern
entries.description: The Shadow Lantern is a unique type of Moonlantern which provides a  Moonshield and grants the unique  Conjure Shadow Lantern Wraith spell.

entries.name: Shattered Flail
entries.description: Shattered Flail is a rare +2 Mace that heals the wielder when they hit an enemy - at the cost of potentially going  mad when they stop attacking.

entries.name: Shortsword +2
entries.description: Shortsword +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Shortswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.

entries.name: Sickle of BOOOAL
entries.description: Sickle of BOOOAL is a rare variant of the Sickles family of weapons. It is a Simple melee weapon wielded in one hand.  It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.

entries.name: Slicing Shortsword
entries.description: The Slicing Shortsword is a rare +1 shortsword that inflicts Bleeding when the wielder attacks with advantage.

entries.name: Sorrow
entries.description: Sorrow is a rare +1 Glaive that grants its wielder the Sorrowful Lash cantrip as  Bonus Action once per turn.

entries.name: Soulbreaker Greatsword
entries.description: Soulbreaker Greatsword is a rare +1 greatsword that grants its wielder the  Soulbreaker weapon action and a bonus to Initiative rolls; it also deals additional Psychic damage when wielded by a githyanki.

entries.name: Spear +2
entries.description: Spear +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) Spear.

entries.name: Spear of Night
entries.description: Spear of Night is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Spears family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.    Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.

entries.name: Staff of Interruption
entries.description: Staff of Interruption is a rare +2 Quarterstaff that allows the wielder to cast Counterspell at Level 5.

entries.name: Staff of the Emperor
entries.description: Staff of the Emperor is a rare +2 Quarterstaff that enhances the wielder's spells and possibly stuns enemy spellcasters.

entries.name: Sussur Dagger
entries.description: The Sussur Dagger is a Rare +1 Dagger which can  Silence the targets it strikes, making it very useful against spellcasters.

entries.name: Sussur Greatsword
entries.description: Sussur Greatsword is a rare +1 Greatsword, which can  Silence targets on hit.

entries.name: Sussur Sickle
entries.description: The Sussur Sickle is a Rare   + 1 Sickle which can silence the targets it strikes, making it very useful against spellcasters.

entries.name: Sword of Clutching Umbra
entries.description: Sword of Clutching Umbra is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) Shortsword that grants the wielder the unique weapon action Shadowsoaked Blow.

entries.name: Sword of the Emperor
entries.description: Sword of the Emperor is a rare +2 Longsword that grants bonus damage against shapeshifted or polymorphed creatures and enhances the wielder's defences against spells.

entries.name: The Baneful
entries.description:
The Baneful is a rare +1 shortsword that applies the  Bane condition on hit.
This blade's magical powers only function if it's  Bound to an Eldritch Knight or is a Warlock's  Pact Weapon.

entries.name: The Sparky Points
entries.description: The Sparky Points is a rare Trident that allows the wielder to generate Lightning Charges upon dealing melee damage with this weapon.

entries.name: The Spellsparkler
entries.description: The Spellsparkler is a rare Quarterstaff that allows the wielder to generate Lightning Charges upon dealing damage with spells.

entries.name: Thermodynamo Axe
entries.description: Thermodynamo Axe is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) Battleaxe that grants Heat whenever the wielder deals damage with this weapon.

entries.name: Thorn Blade
entries.description: Thorn Blade is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) Scimitar that deals 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage with melee weapons attacks while Concentrating and grants the ability to cast  Ensnaring Strike (Melee).

entries.name: Trident +2
entries.description: Trident +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Tridents family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.    Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.

entries.name: Twist of Fortune
entries.description: Twist of Fortune is a rare +1 Morningstar with the unique weapon action,  Blood Money. When the wielder rolls 2 or less with this weapon's damage die, they reroll and take the new result.

entries.name: Unseen Menace
entries.description: Unseen Menace is a rare   + 1 Pike which increases critical hit chance and grants Advantage as long as the wielder keeps connecting hits.

entries.name: Vicious Battleaxe
entries.description: Vicious Battleaxe is a rare +2 Battleaxe that deals additional damage on a Critical Hit.

entries.name: Warhammer +2
entries.description: Warhammer +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Warhammers family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Wavemother's Sickle
entries.description: Wavemother's Sickle is a rare,   + 2 Sickle that grants the wielder Advantage against targets with the Wet condition.

entries.name: Belm
entries.description: Belm is a very rare +2 Scimitar. It grants the Whirlwind Attack and Perfectly Balanced Strike weapon actions.

entries.name: Dwarven Thrower
entries.description: Dwarven Thrower is a very rare +2 Warhammer that returns to the wielder when thrown, and deals extra damage if the wielder is a Dwarf or the target is Large or greater.

entries.name: Foebreaker
entries.description: Foebreaker is a very rare +2 Maul that ignores ⁠Bludgeoning resistance of targets.

entries.name: Halberd of Vigilance
entries.description: Halberd of Vigilance is a very rare +2 Halberd that deals additional Force damage, gives a bonus to Initiative, and grants Advantage on Perception checks and Reactions.

entries.name: Handmaiden's Mace
entries.description: Handmaiden's Mace is a very rare +2 Mace which sets the wielder's Strength to 18.

entries.name: Hellfire Greataxe
entries.description: Hellfire Greataxe is a very rare +2 Greataxe that deals additional Fire damage, afflicts its wielder with Heat on each successful hit, and grants the Hellflame Cleave weapon action.

entries.name: Incandescent Staff
entries.description: Incandescent Staff is a very rare Quarterstaff which grants the wielder a bonus to ranged spell Attack Rolls and resistance to Fire damage. It also grants the ability to cast the Fire Bolt and Fireball spells.

entries.name: Infernal Rapier
entries.description: The Infernal Rapier is a very rare +2 rapier and a possible reward for following Wyll's companion quest. It raises the wielder's Spell Save DC and, unlike other rapiers, uses their Spellcasting Modifier for Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls instead of Strength or Dexterity.

entries.name: Justiciar's Scimitar
entries.description: Justiciar's Scimitar is a very rare +2 Scimitar weapon that can blind an opponent if the wielder strikes with Advantage. It also grants the Shadowsoaked Blow weapon action.

entries.name: Knife of the Undermountain King
entries.description: The Knife of the Undermountain King is a very rare +2 shortsword which increases the frequency of scoring Critical Hits and grants  Advantage against obscured enemies.

entries.name: Mourning Frost
entries.description: Mourning Frost is a very rare +1 Quarterstaff that enhances the wielder's ⁠Cold damaging spells with extra damage and the  Chilled condition.

entries.name: Pelorsun Blade
entries.description: Pelorsun Blade is a very rare +1 Rapier that grants the wielder  Advantage against Undead targets.

entries.name: Rhapsody
entries.description: Rhapsody is a very rare +1 Dagger that grants better Attack Rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC for every foe slain (up to 3) and possibly inflicts Bleeding while the wielder is Hiding or Invisible.

entries.name: Sethan
entries.description: Sethan is a very rare +2 Greataxe that grants its wielder the Sethan: Spiritual Greataxe and Sethan: Reduce weapon actions.

entries.name: Staff of Cherished Necromancy
entries.description: Staff of Cherished Necromancy is a very rare +2 Quarterstaff which greatly enhances Necromancy spells and can use a dead creature's essence to cast a Necromancy spell without costing a spell slot.

entries.name: Staff of Spellpower
entries.description: Staff of Spell Power is a very rare + 2 Quarterstaff. It empowers the wielder's spells and can cast one spell without a expending a spell slot, once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Staff of the Ram
entries.description: The Staff of the Ram is a +2 Quarterstaff that can Stun and push back a target on a hit.

entries.name: Stillmaker
entries.description: Stillmaker is a very rare +2 Dagger that grants the wielder the Hold Person spell once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Sword of Chaos
entries.description: Sword of Chaos is a very rare +2 greatsword which deals additional ⁠⁠Necrotic damage and also restores a portion of the wielder's health on each successful hit.

entries.name: Sword of Life Stealing
entries.description: The Sword of Life Stealing is a very rare +2 shortsword which deals an extra 10 Necrotic damage on a critical hit, and heals the wielder for the same amount.

entries.name: The Dancing Breeze
entries.description: The Dancing Breeze is a very rare +2 Glaive that grants its wielder the Whirlwind Attack weapon action, which strikes all nearby targets.

entries.name: The Sacred Star
entries.description: The Sacred Star is a very rare +2 Morningstar that applies  Radiating Orb on hit and possibly turns the target if it is Undead. It also grants the Dawnburst Strike weapon action.

entries.name: Trident of the Waves
entries.description: Trident of the Waves is a +1 Trident. It creates a  Water surface around the target and also applies the  Wet condition.

entries.name: Voss' Silver Sword
entries.description: Voss' Silver Sword is a very rare +2 Longsword enhanced with additional ⁠Psychic damage. It also grants a bonus to damage and Attack Rolls against githyanki, aberrations, fiends and elementals and well as granting the wielder the ability to cast the Wrathful Smite spell.

entries.name: Woe
entries.description: Woe is a very rare, +2 Quarterstaff wielded by Cazador Szarr. It grants a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls, access to the Blight spell, and healing when creatures fail Saving Throws by the caster's spells.

entries.name: Balduran's Giantslayer
entries.description: Balduran's Giantslayer is a legendary +3 Greatsword that receives doubled damage bonus from Strength, grants its wielder the Giant Form class action and the Topple the Big Folk weapon action, as well as Advantage on attack rolls against Large, Huge, and Gargantuan creatures.

entries.name: Bloodthirst
entries.description: Bloodthirst is a legendary +2 Dagger wielded by Orin which makes critical hits more likely. Also, depending on which hand this weapon is equipped on, it can either make targets vulnerable to Piercing or more likely to be hit.

entries.name: Crimson Mischief
entries.description: Crimson Mischief is a legendary +2 Shortsword that, when wielded in the main hand, grants additional damage when attacking with Advantage and against targets with 50% or less of their hit points. When wielded in the off-hand, it instead allows the wielder to add their Ability Modifier to their damage.

entries.name: Devotee's Mace
entries.description: The Devotee's Mace is a legendary +3 Mace that deals extra Radiant damage on hit, and can create a healing aura which heals the wielder and nearby allies.

entries.name: Duellist's Prerogative
entries.description: Duellist's Prerogative is a legendary +3 Rapier that grants the wielder a greater chance of critical hits, and an extra reaction provided their off-hand is empty. The wielder can also use a reaction to grant additional Necrotic damage on a hit.

entries.name: Markoheshkir
entries.description: Markoheshkir is a legendary +2 Quarterstaff which empowers the wielder's spells and can be tuned towards a certain element, granting extra spells and effects. It can also cast a spell for free, once per long rest.

entries.name: Nyrulna
entries.description: Nyrulna is a legendary +3 Trident which can be thrown to create an explosion that deals Thunder damage in an area. It grants additional movement speed and jump distance and returns to the wielder after being thrown.

entries.name: Selûne's Spear of Night
entries.description: Selûne's Spear of Night is a legendary +3 Spear which allows the wielder to cast Moonbeam and grants Darkvision as well as Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws and Perception Checks.

entries.name: Shar's Spear of Evening
entries.description: Shar's Spear of Evening is a legendary +3 Spear which allows the wielder to gain Shar's Blessing and immunity to blindness.

entries.name: Silver Sword of the Astral Plane
entries.description: The Silver Sword of the Astral Plane is a legendary +3 Greatsword which grants its wielder the  Soulbreaker weapon action and provides special bonuses when wielded by a githyanki.
entries.wikiTitle: Silver Sword of the Astral Plane

entries.name: The Blood of Lathander
entries.description: The Blood of Lathander is a legendary   + 3 Mace found through the ⁠Find the Blood of Lathander quest. It continuously sheds light, blinds nearby Fiends and Undead with its light, can prevent death as well as heal its wielder, and allows the wielder to cast  Sunbeam.

entries.name: Moonlantern
entries.description: The Moonlantern is a special utility item that sheds a magical Light in a large radius while equipped.

entries.name: Orphic Hammer
entries.description: The Orphic Hammer is a legendary, plot-critical +3 Warhammer with the power to shatter infernal bonds. It also grants the wielder Advantage on saving throws vs spells.

entries.name: Torch of Revocation
entries.description: Torch of Revocation is a story rarity +1 utility item carried by Mystic Carrion and used in exorcisms.

entries.name: Allandra's Whelm
entries.description: Allandra's Whelm is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Tridents family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.    Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.

entries.name: Arcane Absorption Dagger
entries.description: Arcane Absorption Dagger is a very rare, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Daggers family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.  Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.

entries.name: Arduous Flame Blade
entries.description: Arduous Flame Blade is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Longswords family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.

entries.name: Azer Warhammer
entries.description: Hits with this weapon deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Fire damage.

entries.name: Blood-Bound Blade

entries.description: Brewing Ladle is a common, variant of the Maces family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand.

As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity or Strength. It is a light weapon which anyone can dual-wield without special training.

entries.name: Gnarled Tree Branch
entries.description: Gnarled Tree Branch is a Greatclub used by some ogres. It can only be obtained by disarming opponents and cannot be wielded by player characters.

entries.name: Goblinbane Dagger

entries.name: Greatclub (Minotaur)

entries.description: Watcher Greatsword is a common greatsword. It can only be wielded by Steel Watchers.

entries.name: Goblin Bow
entries.description: Goblin Bow is the favoured ranged weapon among Goblins. Besides appearances, it functions exactly like a normal Shortbow.

Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Frost is a unique rare Elixir made up of all of a frost dragonborn's best qualities distilled into a bottle. 
You have  Advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion Checks, Resistance to Cold damage, and can use  Ice Storm once until your next Long Rest.

Dwarven blood lets you add your Proficiency Modifier to Saving Throws until you succeed on 3 of them or take a Long Rest.

entries.name: Adrielle
entries.description: Adrielle is a human cleric of Helm who is in Old Garlow's Place in the Lower City during Act Three. She is part of the Anti-Hag Support Group, a group of people who have survived encounters with hags.

entries.name: Alfira
entries.description: Alfira is a tiefling bard and a Temporary Companion in Baldur's Gate 3. She is at the Emerald Grove on a cliff overlooking the ritual, trying to compose a song.

entries.name: Amanita Szarr
entries.description: Amanita Szarr, later known as Lady Incognita, was a prolific author on vampiric matters.

entries.name: Anna Lidwin
entries.description: Anna Lidwin, also known as Sister Lidwin, is a Zealous Assistant who also functions as a trader in Act Two in the House of Healing.

entries.name: Antwun Dufay
entries.description: Chamberlain Dufay is a deceased vampire spawn in the service of Cazador Szarr.

entries.name: Araj Oblodra
entries.description: Araj Oblodra is a drow trader and blood-focused alchemist who is in Moonrise Towers and, later, the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. Other than the items she sells, she also offers unique potions in exchange for samples of blood, and asks to speak with  Astarion.

entries.name: Arnell Hallowleaf
entries.description: Arnell Hallowleaf is a high elven Werewolf,  Selûnite, and father of  Shadowheart. He can potentially become a Camp Follower.

entries.name: Auntie Ethel
entries.description: Auntie Ethel is a fussy trader of potions, lotions, quirks, and sundries who is first located in The Hollow of the Emerald Grove. Later, she returns to her home at the Riverside Teahouse in the Sunlit Wetlands.

entries.name: Baelen Bonecloak
entries.description: Baelen Bonecloak is a dwarf in the Dread Hollow. He is trapped in the Bibberbang Grotto to the northwest of the Myconid Colony as related during the ⁠Find the Mushroom Picker quest given by his wife,  Derryth Bonecloak. If he survives this encounter, he eventually relocates to Bonecloak's Apothecary in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Balthazar
entries.description: Balthazar is an Undead necromancer, who can first be encountered in the Gauntlet of Shar during Act Two.

entries.name: Barcus Wroot
entries.description: Barcus Wroot is an unfortunate deep gnome searching for his friend,  Wulbren Bongle. He can be first be found tied to a windmill in the Blighted Village and can later become a Camp Follower.

entries.name: Belynne Stelmane
entries.description: Belynne Stelmane, was a Duke of Baldur's Gate and leader of the Knights of the Shield. She was recently murdered in her suite at the Elfsong Tavern.

entries.name: Black Hand of Loyalty
entries.description: The Black Hand of Loyalty is an unknown author of several reports towards  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Bloris Meadhoney
entries.description: Head Clerk Meadhoney is the head clerk of the Counting House in the Lower City. He can be spoken with to gain access to the vaults (peacefully).

entries.name: Bombasto
entries.description: Bombasto is a human character in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Brem
entries.description: Brem is a trader in the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.

entries.name: Carmen Pennygood
entries.description: Carmen Pennygood is a merchant who works in the store she owns, Carm's Garms, in Wyrm's Crossing.

entries.name: Cazador Szarr
entries.description: Cazador Szarr is a vampire in Baldur's Gate 3 and Astarion's former master. He is the primary antagonist of Astarion's personal quest, The Pale Elf.

entries.name: Dalyria
entries.description: Dalyria is a Vampire Spawn enslaved to  Cazador, and one of  Astarion's siblings.

entries.name: Derryth Bonecloak
entries.description: Derryth Bonecloak is a gold dwarf and trader in Ebonlake Grotto.

entries.name: Droralias Dryselis

entries.name: Eliette
entries.description: Eliette is a High Elf arachnomancer mentioned in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Elizabeth M. Soot
entries.description: Elizabeth M. Soot is an author who has written about evil beings and how to overcome them.

entries.name: Emmeline Hallowleaf
entries.description: Emmeline Hallowleaf is a Human  Selûnite and the mother of  Shadowheart. She can potentially become a Camp Follower.

entries.name: Enver Gortash
entries.description:
Lord Enver Gortash, often just referred to as Gortash, is the Chosen of  Bane, and one of the leaders of the enigmatic Cult of the Absolute. He serves as one of the main antagonists in Baldur's Gate 3.
Despite his humble beginnings, Gortash quickly rose through the ranks of society in Baldur's Gate with unbridled ambition and great cunning. Now, an influential figure and poised to become the Archduke of the city, he seeks to consolidate his power and become the ruler of the city and beyond, through whatever means are necessary.

entries.name: Ettvard Needle
entries.description: Ettvard Needle is the human editor in chief for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette. He is in the main building, the Baldur's Mouth, in the Lower City.

entries.name: Figaro Pennygood
entries.description: Figaro 'Facemaker' Pennygood is a merchant who owns the store Facemaker's Boutique in the Lower City in Act Three. He is the brother of  Carmen Pennygood, the owner of Carm's Garms in Wyrm's Crossing.

entries.name: Fireliia Jannath
entries.description: Lady Fireliia Jannath is a Human in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Gerringothe Thorm
entries.description: Gerringothe Thorm is a unique intelligent Undead, the toll-master of the Reithwin Tollhouse.

entries.name: Goris Ballast
entries.description: Goris Ballast is staying in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Hahns Rives
entries.description: Hahns Rives is a Black Gauntlet of Bane who oversees the Steel Watch Foundry's underground lab area. He is at X: -1957 Y: 454.

entries.name: Halsin
entries.description:
Halsin is a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. He is a wood elf and a Circle of the Moon Druid with the Outlander background. Halsin can first be found in the Shattered Sanctum during Act One as an attached follower or as a camp follower.
Halsin seeks to create a harmonious balance between nature and civilisation as well as find a cure for the Shadow Curse that has haunted his home for the past century.

entries.name: Haskinn Xhesilaphin
entries.description: Haskinn Xhesilaphin is a prolific Dragonborn alchemist and author mentioned in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Hope
entries.description: Hope is a dwarven Cleric and captive of the House of Hope.

entries.name: Ilyn Toth
entries.description: Ilyn Toth was a human Red Wizard who fled Thay with his apprentice. He became an apothecary in Moonhaven sometime before Nightal of 1371 DR.

entries.name: Infernal Mason
entries.description:
Morfred, or Infernal Mason, is one of many infernal debtors stuck at the House of Hope after making a deal with  Raphael. He can be found cleaning and generally pottering around the House's feast hall.
The party can ask the Mason for information about the House, but he will give only vague answers in reply. He will, however, reveal that he is the architect of Moonrise Towers, and the party will have the opportunity to tell him the state of his creation and the surrounding shadow-cursed lands.

entries.name: Isobel
entries.description: Isobel is a half-elf and cleric of  Selûne, who protects the Last Light Inn in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two. She can also become a Camp Follower.

entries.name: Jaheira
entries.description:
Jaheira is a recruitable companion. She and  Minsc return from both Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn and are the only two recruitable companions who cannot be romanced. She is a high half-elf and a druid with the Soldier background, and can be first found at the Last Light Inn during Act Two.
Having become High Harper in the century since her first adventures, wherein her husband Khalid was killed, Jaheira is deadset on maintaining her Harper network, taking down the Cult of the Absolute, and later reuniting with Minsc, her closest friend. Jaheira is known for her sharp wit and dry humour, and also serves as a mentor figure to the rest of the party.

entries.name: Ketheric Thorm
entries.description: General Ketheric Thorm is an Undead with elven ancestry and appearance, the Chosen of  Myrkul, and one of the leaders of the enigmatic Cult of the Absolute. He serves as one of the main antagonists in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Klagga
entries.description: Tracker Klagga is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Korrilla Hearthflame
entries.description: Korrilla Hearthflame is a gold dwarven agent of  Raphael's. She can be encountered briefly in Act One and Act Two. She later moves to Sharess' Caress, the House of Hope and potentially in the Elfsong Tavern during Act Three.

entries.name: Lenore De Hurst
entries.description: Lenore De Hurst is a cleric of Mystra who lived in the Arcane Tower, where she researched the magical properties of the Underdark.

entries.name: Leon
entries.description: Leon Onufrio is a Vampire Spawn enslaved to  Cazador Szarr. He may appear at Camp or Cazador's Dungeon during Act Three.

entries.name: Listelia Dryselis
entries.description: Listelia Dryselis is a Dragonborn who, like her sister  Droralias Dryselis, was a smuggler for the Knights of the Shield before perishing to the Absolute.

entries.name: Lorgan
entries.description: Father Lorgan was a cleric of Ilmater and a priest of the Open Hand Temple. His corpse is in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Lorroakan
entries.description:
Lorroakan is the human proprietor of Sorcerous Sundries, in Act 3 of Baldur's Gate 3. He is in Ramazith's Tower, after traveling there from Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.
He is searching for something called the Nightsong, and offers a large reward for finding it.

entries.name: Lucretious
entries.description: Madam Lucretious, also known as Bringer of the Night or Mama Lucretious, is a high elven necromancer and the ringmaster of the Circus of the Last Days.

entries.name: Madeline
entries.description: Madeline is a deceased dwarf whose corpse is on the Ruined Battlefield in the Shadow-Cursed Lands at X: 125 Y: 106.

entries.name: Malus Thorm
entries.description: Malus is the undead master surgeon of the House of Healing, twisted follower of  Shar, and member of the Thorm family.

entries.name: Mayrina
entries.description: Mayrina is a human in Act One. She is the widow of  Connor Vinderblad and sister to  Demir and  Johl.

entries.name: Melodia Thorm
entries.description: Melodia Thorm was a member of the Thorm family, the wife of  General Ketheric Thorm and the mother of  Isobel Thorm. She was a devoted follower of  Selûne.

entries.name: Minsc
entries.description:
Minsc of Rashemen is a recruitable Companion. He and  Jaheira return from both Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn and are the only two recruitable companions who cannot be romanced. He is a Human and a Hunter Ranger with the Folk Hero background.
Minsc can first be found in The Counting House, where he has been tadpole-converted by the Absolute into a True Soul and criminal gang-leader known as the Stone Lord. He can be found again in the Abandoned Cistern; knocking him out in the ensuing fight allows him to be freed from his brainwashing. 
After spending nearly a century  Petrified together, Minsc and his beloved hamster sidekick  Boo have finally been revived, and they seek a life of "butt-kicking" evil-doers to serve as a force of goodness, justice, and glory. 
Minsc is also the only character with access to the spell  Find Familiar: Boo.
Though voiced by Matthew Mercer, Minsc was motion-captured by other actors, Neil Newbon amongst them.

entries.name: Minthara
entries.description:
Nightwarden Minthara Baenre is a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. She is a Lolth-Sworn Drow and an Oath of Vengeance Paladin with the Noble background.
Ruthless in service of the Absolute, she commands a camp of goblins planning an attack on the Emerald Grove in the name of their god. Initially hostile, she can be re-encountered during Act Two and saved from execution.

entries.name: Nansi Gretta
entries.description: Nansi Gretta is a character in Act Three who owns The Bibliophile, a bookstore in the Lower City X: -109 Y: -123.

entries.name: Nine-Fingers Keene
entries.description: Nine-Fingers Keene is the human Guildmaster of the Guild in the city of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Nocturne
entries.description: Nocturne, formerly known as Rennald, is a Tiefling follower of  Shar and childhood friend of  Shadowheart.

entries.name: Old Garlow
entries.description: Old Garlow is the former resident of Old Garlow's Place and author of a few works.

entries.name: Omotola
entries.description: Omotola is a human trader who manages The Glitter Gala in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Orin
entries.description: Orin the Red is the Chosen of  Bhaal and one of the leaders of the enigmatic Cult of the Absolute and serves as one of the main antagonists in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Orpheus
entries.description: Orpheus is a Githyanki who appears in Baldur's Gate 3, playing a central role in Act Three and  Lae'zel's personal quest, ⁠The Githyanki Warrior. As the son of Gith herself, he acts as the supposed true ruler of the Gith Empire. However, he has been captured and imprisoned in the Astral Plane by  Vlaakith. Being a githyanki, he seeks to destroy the mind flayers, and as the true githyanki prince, he strives to remove Vlaakith from power.

entries.name: Oskar Fevras
entries.description: Oskar Fevras is a human and well known painter in the city of Baldur's Gate, who is being trafficked by the Zhentarim.

entries.name: Pammella Nortale
entries.description: Pammella Nortale is a halfling in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Pandirna
entries.description: Pandirna is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. With her legs paralysed from a dodgy brew, she is given the duty of guarding the refugees' storage hut.

entries.name: Rakath Glitterbeard
entries.description: Rakath Glitterbeard is the dwarven head banker of the Counting House, in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Raphael
entries.description:
“
     The mouse smiled brightly: it outfoxed the cat! Then down came the claw and that, love, was that.
     „

entries.name: Redhammer
entries.description: Redhammer is a dwarven submarine driver in Flymm Cargo's Basement.

entries.name: Rian Forbeck
entries.description: Rian Forbeck is a traveler and an author who wrote 'The Approachable East' series.

entries.name: Rih'al
entries.description: M'lar Rih'al is a scout who discovered the Rosymorn Monastery is now a location for a githyanki Crèche.

entries.name: Roan Featherway
entries.description: Roan Featherway is a druid of Silvanus and an author who wrote multiple journals, all unpublished drafts of books.

entries.name: Sarevok Anchev
entries.description: Sarevok Anchev is a legendary Bhaalspawn. He was the main antagonist of Baldur's Gate and a possible companion in Baldur's Gate II: Throne of Bhaal. He can be found in the Murder Tribunal under Candulhallow's Tombstones during Act Three.

entries.name: Stornugoss
entries.description: Ghustil Stornugoss is the principal healer of Crèche Y'llek during Act One.

entries.name: The Warden
entries.description: The Warden is at Moonrise Towers Prison during Act Two, where she presides as warden.

entries.name: Therezzyn
entries.description: Kith'rak Therezzyn is the Kith'rak of Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Thisobald Thorm
entries.description: Thisobald Thorm is a unique, intelligent Undead, and the master brewer of The Waning Moon. He is possibly the son of  Ketheric Thorm.

entries.name: Tim Twofingers
entries.description: Tim Twofingers is a sailor who is mentioned in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Ulder Ravengard
entries.description:
Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard is the human Supreme Marshall of the Flaming Fist and the father of  Wyll. His story stretches through all three acts of Baldur's Gate 3, and he can become a Camp Follower late in the game. 
Ulder Ravengard is a recurring character in the Forgotten Realms setting of Dungeons and Dragons, appearing in the 5e adventures:  Murder in Baldur's Gate,  The Rise of Tiamat, and  Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus.

entries.name: Valmorba
entries.description: Valmorba is a high half-elven gravekeeper in the Mortuary within the Graveyard in Baldur's Gate 3. She is a devotee of Kelemvor and manages the graveyard.

entries.name: Vellioth
entries.description: Vellioth "the Martinet" was a vampire lord in Baldur's Gate and the master of  Cazador.  His skull is located in the western wing of Cazador's Dungeon.

entries.name: Viconia DeVir
entries.description: Viconia DeVir is a drow cleric of Shar. She is the Mother Superior of the  Shar enclave in Baldur's Gate. She is a returning character from Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn, where she was a companion.

entries.name: Volo
entries.description: Volothamp Geddarm, or Volo, for short, is a Camp Follower in Baldur's Gate 3. He is first located at the Sacred Pool during Act One, interviewing a bear. Volo is a recurring character in  Forgotten Realms media and a returning character from Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate II: Throne of Bhaal.

entries.name: Withers
entries.description: Withers is a mysterious Undead entity who joins the party on their adventures as a Camp Follower. He calls himself "a scribe, a seneschal - a keeper of records". He offers resurrection and Hireling services to the party, and also allows respeccing of characters.

entries.name: Wulbren Bongle
entries.description: Wulbren Bongle is a deep gnome who leads the Ironhand Gnomes. Wulbren despises the Gondians and the Steel Watch, and works to destroy the Steel Watch Foundry in Baldur's Gate and rid the city of Gondians.

entries.name: Yrre
entries.description: Yrre the Sparkstruck was a gnomish inventor and tinkerer.

entries.name: Z'rell
entries.description: Disciple Z'rell is a high-ranking Absolutist and trusted advisor to  Ketheric Thorm in Moonrise Towers during Act Two.

entries.name: Zanner Toobin
entries.description: Zanner Toobin is a Rock Gnome, first found in the Steel Watch Foundry in Act Three. If the party helps to save the kidnapped Gondians in the Iron Throne, he becomes an Attached Follower while progressing through the Foundry.

entries.name: A is for Azuth, and other Gods
entries.description: A is for Azuth, and other Gods is a series of books in Baldur's Gate 3.
entries.wikiTitle: A is for Azuth, and other Gods

entries.name: Schools of Magic
entries.description: Schools of Magic may refer to one of the following:

entries.name: Absolutist Expedition Trunk
entries.description: Absolutist Expedition Trunk is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown by the player. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Adamantine Chest
entries.description: Adamantine Chest is a Container that can be searched for items, or picked up. It is unusually heavy.

entries.name: Adventurer's Chest
entries.description: Adventurer's Chest is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved.

entries.name: Alchemy Pouch
entries.description: Alchemy Pouch automatically adds most alchemical ingredients into this container, rather than the main inventory.

entries.name: Animal Carcass
entries.description: Animal Carcass is a lightweight Container that can be found throughout the game.

entries.name: Apprentice's Pack
entries.description: Apprentice's Pack is a Container item that can be found throughout the game.

entries.name: Backpack
entries.description: Backpack is a container that can be picked up or thrown. Usually contains consumables, equipment, miscellaneous items and other randomized loot. There are multiple color variants of this item.

entries.name: Baelen's Pack
entries.description: Baelen's Pack is a Container item that can be found throughout the game. There are multiple variants of this item.

entries.name: Bag of Moulding
entries.description: Bag of Moulding is a Container that will rot any food that is put inside of it.

entries.name: Bloated Fish
entries.description: Bloated Fish is a backup Container item carrying the Netherstones, if the party dropped them in the Iron Throne and both the Sahuagin on the beach and Old Troutman are dead.

entries.name: Bottle Rack
entries.description: Bottle Rack is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Usually empty.

entries.name: Bucket of Fish
entries.description: Bucket of Fish is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown by the player. Usually contains Fish.

entries.name: Burlap Sack
entries.description: Burlap Sack (also called Pouch) is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown. It usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Camp Supply Sack
entries.description: Camp Supply Sack automatically adds most Camp Supply items into this bag, rather than the main inventory.

entries.name: Caravan Strongbox
entries.description: Caravan Strongbox is a container found during the quest Find the Missing Shipment.

entries.name: Cartilaginous Chest
entries.description: Cartilaginous Chest is a type of Container found in the areas related to Mind Flayers. It can be picked up or thrown. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Chest of Grateful Words
entries.description: The Chest of Grateful Words is a container found in Baldur's Gate 3's epilogue. It contains letters from many of the characters that the party interacted with during their journey.

entries.name: Chest of the Mundane
entries.description: The Chest of the Mundane is a gilded chest that makes items in it appear to be mundane objects.

entries.name: Clothing Chest
entries.description: Clothing Chest is a common Medium Toughness Container.

entries.name: Cormyte Shipment Box
entries.description: Cormyte Shipment Box is a type of Container that can be placed or thrown.

entries.name: Crude Chest
entries.description: Crude Chest is a miscellaneous container.

entries.name: Curious Book
entries.description: Curious Book is a common Miscellaneous item. It is a hollow book which contains some loot and can be used as any of the various Containers in the world, like a Backpack.

entries.name: Dale Shipment Trunk
entries.description: Dale Shipment Trunk is a type of Container that can be placed or thrown by the player.

entries.name: Damaged Vase
entries.description: Damaged Vase is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up. Usually empty.

entries.name: Decorated Barrel
entries.description: Decorated Barrel is a type of Container which can be picked up or thrown by the party members. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Document Chest
entries.description: Document Chest is a container used to store valuables.

entries.name: Elaborate Reliquary
entries.description: The Elaborate Reliquary is a Container found on the Nautiloid. It is of Medium size and has 50 Hit Points.

entries.name: Elegant Chest
entries.description: The Elegant Chest is a Container. It is of Medium size and has 25 Hit Points.

entries.name: Fish Barrel
entries.description: Fish Barrel is a Container item found throughout the game.

entries.name: Gale's Pouch
entries.description: Gale's Pouch is a small pouch containing items to be used in case of Gale's death.

entries.name: Gilded Chest
entries.description: Gilded Chest is a container that can be picked up or thrown by the player. Usually contains consumables, miscellaneous items and other loot.

entries.name: Grimy Chest
entries.description: Grimy Chest is a Sturdy container.

entries.name: Hand Bag
entries.description: Hand Bag is a story version of the standard Pouch that can be found after defeating Dolor. It contains the severed hands of Dolor's victims.

entries.name: Harper Stash
entries.description: Harper Stash is a medium-sized container with 25 Hit Points. It contains a Scroll and Scroll of Evidence.

entries.name: Heavy Backpack
entries.description: Heavy Backpack is a Container item that can be found throughout the game.

entries.name: Heavy Chest
entries.description: Heavy Chest is a common container used to store valuables.

entries.name: Hunter's Stash
entries.description:
Hunter's Stash is a type of Static Clutter Container that can be found throughout the Forest in Act One.
Usually the stash is empty.

entries.name: Innkeeper's Lockbox
entries.description: Innkeeper's Lockbox is a Container that can be picked up or thrown by the player.

entries.name: Kanon's Belongings
entries.description: Kanon's Belongings is a Container that can be found in the Emerald Grove.

entries.name: Keychain
entries.description: Keychain automatically adds most keys into this container, rather than the main inventory.

entries.name: Loose Plank
entries.description:
Loose Plank is a type of Static Clutter Container that can be found throughout Act Two and Act Three of the game.
Usually contains valuable or quest-significant items and requires from  DC 10 Perception Check to  DC 20 Perception Check to find.

entries.name: Magical Walnut
entries.description: Magical Walnut is a Container that can be won from Akabi's wheel.

entries.name: Metal Crate
entries.description: Metal Crate is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown by the player. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Metal Trunk
entries.description: Metal Trunk is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown by the player. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Moonstone
entries.description: The Moonstone is an environmental object found on top of the Selûne statue in the Selûnite Outpost.

entries.name: Moss-Covered Chest
entries.description: Moss-Covered Chest is a sturdy container found in Act One.

entries.name: Old Backpack
entries.description: Old Backpack is a Container item.

entries.name: Old Pouch
entries.description: Old Pouch is a Container.

entries.name: Open Crate
entries.description: Open Crate is a type of Container that can not be picked up

entries.name: Opulent Chest
entries.description: Opulent Chest is a container that can be picked up or thrown. Usually contains consumables, equipment, miscellaneous items and other randomized loot.

entries.name: Ornate Chest
entries.description: Ornate Chest is a Container that can be found in Act One. It can be picked up or thrown by the player. Always contains Harper's Notebook, Harper's Map, and a few additional items.

entries.name: Painted Chest
entries.description: Painted Chest is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized loot.

entries.name: Patched-Together Sack
entries.description: The Patched-Together Sack is a container. It is of Tiny size and has 4 Hit Points.

entries.name: Peculiar Clothing Chest
entries.description: Peculiar Clothing Chest is a Container that can be found in the Traveller's Chest at camp after installing the Digital Deluxe Upgrade. This chest and its contents are a reference to Divinity: Original Sin II.

entries.name: Pickpocket's Bag
entries.description: Pickpocket's Bag is a Container item given to the player by Mol.

entries.name: Pile of Books
entries.description: Pile of Books is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Usually empty or containing various books, notes, and scrolls.

entries.name: Pouch
entries.description: Pouch is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown by the player. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Ribcage
entries.description: Ribcage is a lightweight Container that can be found throughout the game.

entries.name: Rosewood Desk
entries.description: Rosewood Desk is a type of Static Clutter Container that can be found throughout the game. Usually contains items such as Ink Pot, Quill and Ink Pot and Quill.

entries.name: Row of Books
entries.description: Row of Books is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Usually contains various books, notes or scrolls.

entries.name: Rustic Chest
entries.description: Rustic Chest is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown by the player. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Shabby Wardrobe
entries.description: Shabby Wardrobe is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Usually contains random poor Camp Clothing and Miscellaneous items such as Rags.

entries.name: Shelf
entries.description: Shelves are a a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Usually contains Miscellaneous items such as Cup or Knife.

entries.name: Shiny Chest
entries.description: Shiny Chest is a container found in the Emerald Grove.

entries.name: Smelly Bag
entries.description: Smelly Bag is a container found in Act Three.

entries.name: Spider Silk Cocoon
entries.description: Spider Silk Cocoon is an environmental object and a container Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Stack of Books
entries.description: Stack of Books is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Usually empty or containing various books, notes, and scrolls.

entries.name: Stone Tablets
entries.description: Stone Tablets is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Usually empty or containing various books, and scrolls.

entries.name: Storage Box
entries.description: Storage Box is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved.

entries.name: Storage Chest
entries.description: Storage Chest are a common Medium Toughness Container.

entries.name: Strongbox
entries.description: Strongbox is a type of Static Clutter Container that can be found throughout Act Three of the game. Usually contains valuable items and requires  DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check to lockpick.

entries.name: Stuffed Bear (Container)
entries.description: Stuffed Bear is a common Miscellaneous item. It is a stuffed bear that contains a note, and can be used as a Container, like a Backpack.

entries.name: Table
entries.description: Table is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Usually empty. It is identical to the destructible type of Wooden Desk.

entries.name: Thayan Shipment Box
entries.description: Thayan Shipment Box is a type of Container that can be placed or thrown.

entries.name: Toy Chest
entries.description: A tiny chest that can be found in the Grymforge. Interacting with it reveals another chest.

entries.name: Transport Barrel
entries.description: A Transport Barrel is a special type of container that can be thrown by an Ogre Brute to transport a goblin past defences.

entries.name: Travel-Worn Chest
entries.description: Travel-Worn Chest is a container that can be found during Act One.

entries.name: Traveller's Chest
entries.description: The Traveller's Chest is a chest located in the party's Campsite. All the different campsites have designated places for the Traveller's Chest and any item inside it persists between all camps. By right-clicking an item in the inventory it is possible to send it directly to the Traveller's Chest from anywhere by choosing "Send to Camp".

entries.name: Traveller's Chest (small)
entries.description: Traveller's Chest is a type of static clutter Container which cannot be picked up or moved. It usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Vase
entries.description: Vase is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up but can be moved. Usually empty, although it may contain keys, notes, and other miscellaneous loot.

entries.name: Watertight Chest
entries.description: Watertight Chest is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. It contains the  Intransigent Warhammer.

entries.name: Wicker Chest
entries.description: The Wicker Chest is a container found in the Tiefling Hideout. It is of Medium size and has 5 Hit Points.

entries.name: Wooden Barrel
entries.description: Wooden Barrel is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown by the player. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Wooden Chest
entries.description: Wooden Chest is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown by the player. They usually contain Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Wooden Crate (Emerald Enclave)
entries.description: Wooden Crate is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Wooden Crate (regular)
entries.description: Wooden Crate is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Wooden Crate (Zhentarim)
entries.description: Wooden Crate is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: Wooden Desk
entries.description: Wooden Desk is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Usually contains items such as Ink Pot, Quill and Ink Pot and Quill.

entries.name: Wooden Shelf
entries.description: Wooden Shelf is a static clutter container that cannot be picked up or moved. Always empty.

entries.name: Wooden Trunk
entries.description: Wooden Trunk is a type of Container that can be picked up or thrown by the player. Usually contains Consumables, Equipment, Miscellaneous items and other randomized common loot.

entries.name: 'Let's meet'
entries.description: 'Let's meet' is a cryptic message to meet at an unspecified location tomorrow.

entries.name: 'Miracles' of the Outer City
entries.description: A record of alleged miraculous phenomena in the outskirts of Baldur's Gate attributed to Ilmater.

entries.name: 'Missing' Poster
entries.description: 'Missing' Poster is a document about missing persons. It does not contain readable text. Instead, interacting with it initiates a voiceover.

entries.name: 'One last chance'
entries.description: 'One last chance' is an ultimatum to meet tonight or never again.

entries.name: 'To silence'
entries.description: 'To silence' is a hit list of people who need to be removed.

entries.name: A Future (To Vilmina)
entries.description: A Future (To Vilmina) is an unsent letter written to Vilmina from Norya Baker.

entries.name: A Greeting to this Home's New Occupants
entries.description: A Greeting to this Home's New Occupants is a letter written to the future residents of Old Garlow's Place.
entries.wikiTitle: A Greeting to this Home's New Occupants

entries.name: A Heartfelt Confession
entries.description: A Heartfelt Confession is a letter requesting a lock of hair.

entries.name: A Home for Every Working Baldurian!
entries.description: A Home for Every Working Baldurian! is a flyer that can be found in Baldur's Gate.
entries.wikiTitle: A Home for Every Working Baldurian!

entries.name: A Letter For Home
entries.description: A Letter For Home is addressed to Gorran Penghyst, written by his son.

entries.name: A letter from the Healer
entries.description: A letter from the Healer is correspondence from Doctor Hagerty to Derryth Bonecloak regarding Derryth's husband, Baelen.

entries.name: A Little Gift
entries.description: A Little Gift is a note which encourages Flaming Fist  Marcus to make good use of an opportunity.

entries.name: A Memory (To Vilmina)
entries.description: A Memory (To Vilmina) is a love poem written to Vilmina from Norya Baker.

entries.name: A Murderous Masterpiece
entries.description: A Murderous Masterpiece is a report written by  Shallar Gujj.

entries.name: A Negotiation
entries.description: A Negotiation is a note from Enver Gortash to Antiope.

entries.name: A Note from Vompter
entries.description: A Note from Vompter is a note instructing  Miklaur to store the djinni lamp in the vault.

entries.name: HELP!
entries.description: HELP! is an urgent plea for help, never delivered.

entries.description: Hey Dez is a note to Dez Kanshaw from Three-Piece threatening him to let his son join The Guild.

entries.description: Highcliff's Blueprints is a Story-related Book. Reading it will add, or update, a journal entry relating to the Finish the Masterwork Weapon Quest. Passing a Nature Skill Check will give further information on where to find Sussur Tree Bark.

entries.name: Home Post Dispatch: Fist Krill
entries.description: A Fist's letter to their mother complaining about insomnia and  Steel Watchers.

entries.name: Hoof-Trodden Diary
entries.description: Hoof-Trodden Diary is written by someone who is haunted by a hag. Despite its name and text, the image of this diary is written on a sheet of paper.

entries.name: Household Prayer
entries.description: Household Prayer seeks the grace of Lathander, Selûne, and Kelemvor.

entries.description: How to Kill a Hag is a note which calls the Anti-Hag Support Group together for an urgent meeting.

entries.description: I Can Save Your Child is a note from Auntie Ethel.

entries.name: I Have a Serious Complaint!

entries.description: I Miss You! is a letter describing instruments in Calimport.

entries.description: Immiscibility of Fluids mandates the use of 'pink fluid expurgation' in Steel Watch maintenance.

entries.name: Improvised Letter
entries.description: Improvised Letter is a letter the player player character can receive in the Epilogue from Gale's Spectral Voice if he detonated the orb to kill the  Netherbrain or died attempting to claim the  Crown of Karsus.

entries.description: In Service of the Night is a note written by Viconia DeVir, the Mother Superior of the hidden cloister of  Shar, about  Shadowheart.

entries.description:
Letter to Kagha contains secret correspondence between the druid Kagha and an order of Shadow Druids.
Reading this item allows the party to confront Kagha about her intentions in ⁠Investigate Kagha.

entries.description: Letter to Yrre was written by Lenore.

entries.description: Letter with Sticky Red Blots is the second of a series of letters.

entries.description: List of Missing Goods is a common note.

entries.description: Management Warning is a warning from  Syllabub Fran's employer for being drunk on the job.
